title: Corporate Graphic Designer
description:
This role sits with a manufacturer of cabinetry and building products, and covers the full range of corporate collateral: product catalogs, spec books, technical product documentation, brochures, flyers,
 marketing assets, and sales presentations. The work asks for two things at once. One is a modern, sophisticated visual style held consistently across every deliverable. The other is information design - the ability to take specifications, dimensions, options, and part numbers and turn them into something a buyer or a specifier can read and compare without effort. You will work with internal teams to gather what a project needs, then d
 for yourself how it should be structured. Briefs will not arrive as step-by-step instructions. You will run several projects at once, hold your own deadlines, present your thinking to stakeholders, and take feedback with judgment rather than simply doing as told.



What you’ll do

Design product catalogs and spec books that stay readable across many products and pages

Produce technical and product documentation from raw specification data

Design brochures, flyers, and
 marketing assets

Build sales and pitch presentations that hold a consistent visual standard

Maintain one polished visual style across every deliverable

Assess a project objective and audience, then d
 independently how to structure and present the information

Work with internal teams to gather requirements and source content

Run several concurrent projects and meet deadlines without day-to-day supervision

Present design concepts to stakeholders and incorporate feedback with sound judgment



What we’re looking for

Proven professional experience as a graphic designer, ideally in a corporate, product, manufacturing, architectural, or B2B environment

Strong layout and typography skills

Strong visual hierarchy and information organisation

Experience designing product catalogs and spec books

Experience designing brochures and flyers

Experience designing sales and business presentations

Experience designing
 marketing material

Experience designing technical or product documentation

Industry-standard graphic design software - Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop

A strong portfolio demonstrating a modern, sophisticated design style

Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects at once



Nice to have

Design experience in the manufacturing or architectural sector

Strong understanding of current design trends

Experience creating polished sales and pitch presentations

Experience working remotely or in a distributed team

Strong aesthetic judgment combined with information-design skill

title: Healthcare Patient Enrollment & Outreach Specialist
description:
About the Role



Great Speech is seeking a warm, personable, and highly motivated Healthcare Patient Enrollment & Outreach Specialist to serve as the first point of contact for individuals and families seeking speech therapy services.



This role combines customer service, patient advocacy, and sales. You will guide prospective clients through the enrollment process, verify insurance benefits, answer questions, conduct follow-up outreach, and help individuals take the next step toward receiving the care they need.



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, communicates with confidence and empathy, and understands how to build trust while encouraging clients to move forward with services. The ideal candidate is organized, adaptable, and comfortable juggling multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced virtual environment.



Key Responsibilities

Contact prospective clients who have expressed interest in services through online inquiries, referrals, and other lead sources.

Conduct outreach calls to introduce Great Speech services and answer client questions.

Verify insurance benefits and assist clients in understanding their coverage options.

Follow up consistently with prospective clients to encourage enrollment and completion of required paperwork.

Guide clients through the onboarding and intake process from inquiry to scheduling.

Document all communications accurately within company systems.

Maintain a high level of responsiveness and professionalism across phone,
, text, and virtual communication channels.

Build rapport and establish trust with clients and families during what may be a stressful or emotional time.

Collaborate with scheduling, clinical, billing, and administrative teams to ensure a smooth client experience.

Assist with additional administrative and operational projects during slower periods.

Support evening and weekend coverage needs as part of a flexible team environment.

Qualifications

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong customer service and relationship-building abilities.

Comfortable making outbound calls and conducting follow-up outreach.

Sales, enrollment, admissions, healthcare, insurance, or customer success experience preferred.

Ability to communicate with warmth, empathy, and professionalism.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a remote environment.

Comfortable learning new technology platforms and software systems.

Reliable internet connection and dedicated home office workspace.

Preferred Characteristics



We are looking for someone who:



Genuinely enjoys helping people improve their lives.

Has a positive, friendly, and engaging personality.

Is comfortable encouraging prospective clients to move forward with services.

Thrives in a team-oriented environment.

Is flexible, adaptable, and willing to jump in wherever support is needed.

Takes ownership of their work and follows through on commitments.

Remains calm and professional when managing multiple tasks at once.

Schedule

Remote position.

Must be available to work Eastern Time (EST).

Flexibility to support afternoon, evening, and weekend coverage is required.

Schedule may vary based on client demand and operational needs.

Why Join Great Speech?



At Great Speech, we believe communication changes lives. Every day, we help children, adults, and seniors access the speech therapy services they need, regardless of where they live. As part of our team, you'll play a meaningful role in helping individuals and families access life-changing care while working alongside a mission-driven team that values compassion, excellence, and service.

title: Local Partnerships and Implementation Lead
description:
Launch and operate our local partner network in 30–90 days by securing signed partnership agreements, booking facilities, coordinating public service clinics, and standing up the first training cohorts—while keeping the program strictly non-political, people-first, and privacy-safe.



Core Outcomes (what success looks like)



Partnerships signed: At least five priority partners in the first 60 days (county or city human services office, workforce board, community college or adult education provider, community health clinic, community organization such as a YMCA).



Compliance ready: Data use and privacy agreements executed; facility use agreements executed; zero mishandling of personal information.



Operational launch: Evening and weekend clinic calendar published; rooms and equipment confirmed; staff roster and duty schedule in place.



Throughput: Weekly clinics and navigator caseload targets met; problem cases escalated and resolved quickly.



Stakeholder trust: Positive written feedback from partner leads; no political messaging incidents.



Reporting: On-time weekly and monthly reports covering timeliness, re-application rates, exemption handling, calls resolved without transfer, class enrollments, certifications, job interviews, and placements.



Key Duties



Partner origination and management



Identify, pitch, and secure partners: workforce board, community college or adult education provider, community health clinic, county or city human services, community organizations with evening space (for example, YMCA, libraries, faith venues).



Draft and route partnership agreements and facility use agreements; coordinate signatures and renewals.



Schedule joint planning calls, site walk-throughs, and monthly quality huddles.



Clinic and class operations



Publish a 90-day schedule for public service clinics (document preparation, benefit renewal support, and exemption screening) and training sessions (for example, safety courses and solar assembly fundamentals).



Book evening and weekend rooms; arrange equipment, internet access, and sign-in procedures.

Privacy, data, and quality



Implement consent forms, data minimization, and safe storage rules; maintain a clear list of who can see what data and why.



Keep separate any health-related notes from public benefit case notes; escalate any risk or crisis per protocol.



Produce weekly and monthly reports; track issues and corrective actions.



Required Experience and Skills



Proven record building partnerships with government, colleges, health clinics, or community organizations.



Experience launching multi-site community programs on short timelines, including nights and weekends.



Comfortable routing and closing simple legal documents: partnership agreements, data use and privacy agreements, facility agreements.



Strong written and spoken English; another local language is a plus.



Calm, non-political communication style; excellent judgment about privacy and consent.



Competent with online scheduling, spreadsheets, video meetings, and a client tracking system.

title: Virtual Operations Assistant / Dispatcher (Limousine & Black-Car) — Full-Time
description:
Empire Black Truck is a fast-paced limousine and black-car transportation company. We're hiring an experienced Virtual Dispatcher to run our daily operations: claiming jobs, assigning drivers, monitoring live trips, and keeping every job and payment accurately tracked.



This is not an entry-level role. Jobs are posted in WhatsApp groups all day and can be taken by another company within seconds. You must stay focused, react fast, and make accurate decisions under pressure.





What You'll Do Claim jobs (fast)

Monitor multiple WhatsApp dispatcher groups and private chats throughout your shift

Before accepting a job, immediately check drivers' live locations, current assignments and upcoming schedules to confirm we can cover it

Accept profitable jobs quickly and accurately





Assign & confirm

Assign or pre-book the right driver based on location, vehicle, availability and profitability

Send complete trip information and confirm the driver received it

Prevent scheduling conflicts and double bookings

Verify driver and vehicle readiness before every assignment





Monitor every active trip

Know when the driver is on location, when the passenger is on board, and when the trip is completed

If a driver is late, unresponsive or has an issue: contact the driver immediately, notify the right person, and arrange backup coverage

Handle airport pickups and last-minute schedule changes calmly





Track everything in Google Sheets

Log every job: trip date/time, pickup and drop-off, passenger info, assigned driver, the company that provided the job, and the specific dispatcher who sent it

Record total job amount, driver pay, expected profit, payment terms, due date, and payment status (paid / pending / late)

Follow up on outstanding payments so nothing slips





Protect the business

Maintain strict confidentiality on customers, rates, company margins, driver compensation and all internal information







Who We're Looking For Required

Previous experience in limousine, black-car, taxi, NEMT, airport transportation, courier, food delivery or another fast-paced last-mile / live-passenger operation

Comfortable with live passenger transportation and jobs that must be claimed immediately

Strong written and verbal English

Excellent organization, multitasking and attention to detail

Sound judgment in a fast-paced environment; able to work independently and take initiative

Reliable high-speed internet, backup power/internet, and a working computer

Professional, dependable, trustworthy





Strongly preferred

Experience dispatching via WhatsApp

Experience tracking jobs and payments in Google Sheets

Familiarity with limo/black-car booking or CRM systems





Please note: experience limited to 3PL trucking, truckload scheduling or HVAC dispatch is generally not a fit for this role. Those industries operate very differently from limousine and taxi dispatch. Apply only if you have live passenger / last-mile dispatch experience.





Schedule & Compensation

Full-time, US Eastern Time hours

Approximately $5/hour, based on experience

Long-term role with a company that values reliability and initiative



How to Apply Send the following (applications missing these will not be reviewed):

Your updated resume

A brief description of your previous dispatch or transportation experience — which industry (limo, taxi, NEMT, courier, etc.)

The number of drivers you have managed at one time

Any dispatch, booking, CRM or transportation systems you have used — and whether you've dispatched via WhatsApp and tracked jobs in Google Sheets

Your available working hours in US Eastern Time

Confirmation that you can work at approximately $5/hour





Tip: start your application with the word "BLACK CAR" so we know you read the full posting.

title: Senior Meta Ads Strategist / Media Buyer — High-Ticket Lead Generation
description:
Remote | Philippines preferred | Part-time / Hourly | Long-term opportunity



About Us



We’re a growing UK-based revenue growth agency working primarily with established online service businesses.



We’re currently building out the paid acquisition arm of our core client programme, The Velocity System™.



Our clients already have their offer and sales infrastructure optimised before paid acquisition begins. Our job at this stage is simple:



Generate more qualified demand into a sales system that is ready to convert it.



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Meta Ads Strategist / Media Buyer who can initially work directly with me to help build, document and refine this part of our delivery — and then manage Meta campaigns across our client portfolio as we scale.



This is not a junior media buying or ads VA role.



I’m looking for someone who understands the strategy behind successful paid acquisition and can tell me what we should be doing — not someone who needs me to teach them how to run Meta ads.



What You'll Own



You'll be responsible for the strategy and performance of
 and Instagram advertising campaigns for our clients.



This will include:



Developing Meta paid acquisition strategies

Building and launching campaigns in Meta Ads Manager

Recommending campaign structures, budgets and testing plans

Reviewing ICP, offer and funnel before launch

Working with us to develop ad angles and creative testing strategies

Briefing our creative team on what needs to be tested

Managing audiences and targeting

Monitoring and optimising campaigns

Identifying winning and losing ads quickly

Scaling winning campaigns

Managing creative fatigue and recommending new iterations

Tracking and improving CPL

Tracking cost per qualified lead

Tracking cost per booked call

Monitoring show rates and lead quality

Tracking CAC and revenue where attribution allows

Troubleshooting campaign and tracking issues

Producing clear performance reporting

Turning campaign data into actionable recommendations



Most importantly, we care about what happens AFTER the lead is generated.



Our sales infrastructure tracks opportunities through the wider journey:



Lead → Qualification → Booked Call → Show → Sales Opportunity → Closed Client → Revenue



You will work alongside our sales/operations team so we're not optimising campaigns purely around cheap leads.



We want to understand:



Which campaigns, audiences, angles and creatives are actually generating qualified opportunities and revenue?



Building the Velocity Paid Acquisition Methodology (The Velocity Scaling Club)



This is an important part of the role.



We're building this department in-house, so initially you'll also work with me to establish our repeatable paid acquisition methodology.



This may include helping us define:



Client paid-acquisition readiness criteria

Minimum requirements before launching ads

Recommended starting budgets

Campaign build standards

Testing methodology

Creative testing framework

Optimisation rules

Scaling rules

Tracking requirements

Core KPIs

Reporting structure

Client communication/reporting cadence

Campaign QA processes

Troubleshooting processes

SOPs and documentation



You don't need to build all of this alone.



But I do need someone experienced enough to contribute meaningfully and say:



“This is how I recommend we structure this, and here's why.”



Who We're Looking For



You should have:



3+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience

Strong experience with
 + Instagram lead generation

Experience managing meaningful client ad spend

Experience with high-ticket service businesses

Experience generating applications and/or booked sales calls

Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager

Strong campaign testing and optimisation skills

Experience scaling successful campaigns

Strong understanding of Pixel, CAPI and conversion tracking

Understanding of attribution

Ability to diagnose whether poor performance is coming from the ad, creative, funnel, offer or sales process

Experience using sales data to evaluate lead quality

Strong analytical skills

Excellent attention to detail

Clear written English

Strong documentation and reporting habits



Experience with agencies, coaches, consultants, education businesses or other online service providers would be particularly valuable.



This Role Is NOT For You If...

Your main experience is ecommerce

You've mainly run boosted posts or engagement campaigns

You judge campaign success purely by CPL

You need someone else to tell you exactly what campaigns to build

You don't understand tracking or attribution

You don't analyse what happens to leads after they enter the funnel

You don't enjoy testing and analysing data

Your Meta knowledge isn't current

You're uncomfortable challenging an idea when the data suggests we should do something differently



I'm very open to being challenged.



If you know more about Meta ads than I do, that's exactly why I'm hiring you.



How You'll Work With Our Creative Team



You'll work closely with a Paid Social Creative Strategist / Copywriter / Editor.



The creative team will support with:



Research

Angles

Hooks

Scripts

Creative briefs

Ad copy

Video editing

Creative variations



Your job is to help turn performance data into the next creative decision.



For example:



Angle A performs poorly → stop testing



Angle B produces qualified booked calls → develop additional variations



Creative B2 becomes the strongest performer → produce new hooks/iterations around the same concept



We want a continuous:



Create → Test → Analyse → Iterate → Scale



loop.



Hours & Compensation



This will initially be a part-time, hourly position with the opportunity for hours and responsibility to increase as our paid acquisition client portfolio grows.



Budget: approximately $10–$15+ USD/hour depending on experience.



I'm willing to consider higher rates for an exceptional candidate with strong high-ticket lead-generation experience and demonstrable results.



We are specifically open to candidates based in the Philippines.



This is intended to become a long-term role rather than a short-term freelance project.



How To Apply



Please don't send a generic application.



Start your application with:



VELOCITY



Then submit a Loom video answer the following:



1. How many years have you personally managed Meta ads?



2. What types of businesses have you primarily run ads for?



3. Tell me about your strongest HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION campaign. Please include, where available:



Monthly ad spend

Leads generated

CPL

Qualified leads

Booked calls

Cost per booked call

Sales

CAC

Revenue / ROAS



4. What is the largest monthly Meta ad spend you've personally managed?



5. If a campaign was producing a very low CPL but the sales team said the leads were terrible, what would you investigate?



6. If an ad angle was consistently generating the highest-quality booked calls, how would you approach scaling it?



7. How do you d
 whether poor performance is caused by the creative, campaign, funnel, offer or sales process?



8. What tracking setup would you expect to have in place for a high-ticket lead-generation funnel?



9. Have you helped an agency create SOPs, processes or a repeatable paid-media delivery methodology before? If yes, tell me about it.



10. Please share 2–3 relevant case studies or examples of campaigns you have personally managed.



If possible, include screenshots or supporting evidence.



Important



I'm not looking for the cheapest person.



I'm looking for someone who is extremely good at Meta advertising, commercially minded, obsessed with the numbers and excited about helping us build an exceptional paid acquisition service.



If you're someone who looks beyond Ads Manager and wants to understand:



Did we generate the right lead?



Did they book?



Did they show?



Were they qualified?



Did they buy?



What did it cost us to acquire that customer?



...then I'd love to hear from you.

title: Static Ad Creative Designer for DTC Brands
description:
Hello, we are looking to hire a full-time Static Ads Designer to support our agency with high-quality ecommerce ad creatives.



We help ecommerce brands grow through paid ads, creative strategy, and better marketing systems.



This is not a basic graphic design role.



This is not a “make pretty Canva graphics” role.



You will help create static ads that are clear, modern, conversion-focused, and built for real ecommerce brands running paid ads.



The goal is not just to make ads look nice, but to help people stop, understand the offer, click, and buy.



For the right person, this role can grow into a larger creative role over time.



What success looks like in this role



• Static ads are delivered on time

• Designs are clean, clear, and easy to understand

• Creative briefs are followed accurately

• Ads have strong visual hierarchy

• Product benefits, offers, reviews, and angles are presented clearly

• Revisions are handled quickly

• Small details are not missed

• Design files are organized properly

• Communication is clear during work hours



Core responsibilities



Daily / Ongoing



• Designing static ads for Meta/Facebook and Instagram

• Turning creative briefs into strong visual ads

• Creating ad variations for testing

• Using product images, reviews, benefits, offers, and competitor examples

• Designing promotional ads, product ads, testimonial ads, and benefit-led ads

• Following brand guidelines while still making the ad conversion-focused

• Making revisions based on feedback

• Organizing files in Figma, Canva, Google Drive, or similar tools



Weekly



• Creating batches of static ads for ecommerce clients

• Reviewing competitor ads for inspiration

• Improving older ad designs

• Adapting one concept into multiple versions or sizes

• Helping build a stronger creative library



What we care most about



Strong visual taste

Your designs should look clean, modern, and professional.



Clear visual hierarchy

People should understand the main message quickly.



Attention to detail

Spacing, alignment, font sizes, colors, image quality, typos, and consistency matter.



Speed with quality

You should move fast without making careless mistakes.



Ability to follow instructions

Creative briefs need to be followed carefully.



Clear communication

You should be responsive during your scheduled hours and proactive when you are stuck or behind.



Openness to feedback

You should be comfortable receiving feedback and improving your work.



Long-term mindset

We are looking for someone who can grow with the team, not just complete one-off tasks.



Skills and experience



• Static ad design experience

• Ecommerce design experience

• Canva, Figma, Photoshop, or Illustrator experience

• Strong layout and typography skills

• Strong written English

• Ability to work from creative briefs

• Organized file management

• Reliable communication



Bonus if you have experience with:



• Meta/Facebook ad creatives

• Direct response design

•
 Ad Library research

• Creative strategy

•
 design

• Landing page design

• AI creative tools

• Motion graphics

• Shopify assets

• Klaviyo
 design



Experience matters less than taste, speed, reliability, and willingness to learn.



Who this role is NOT for



This role is not a fit if:



• You only want to make pretty designs without thinking about results

• You dislike feedback or revisions

• You often miss small details

• You need constant supervision

• You cannot follow creative briefs carefully

• You are slow to respond during workdays

• You only want short-term freelance work

• You are not interested in ecommerce, ads, or performance marketing



Schedule



Full-time role.



40 hours per week.



We prefer someone available Monday to Friday and able to communicate consistently during the week.



Compensation



$600 to $800/month depending on experience, quality of work, speed, and reliability.



Questions



Question 1:

What design tools do you use most often, and what is your experience level with each?



Question 2:

Do you have experience designing static ads for ecommerce brands or paid ads?



Question 3:

Please share your portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.



Question 4:

What makes a static ad effective in your opinion?



Question 5:

Are you looking for a full-time, long-term role?



Important



To apply, start your application message with the word Creative on the first line.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



Trial task



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete 1 small paid trial task.



The trial task will help us understand your design taste, speed, attention to detail, ability to follow a brief, and understanding of ecommerce ads.



Growth path



First 30 days



• Follow briefs accurately

• Deliver clean static ads consistently

• Communicate clearly during work hours

• Organize files properly

• Improve based on feedback

• Build trust through reliability



After 60 to 90 days



• Create stronger ad variations with less guidance

• Understand ecommerce ad angles better

• Suggest new creative directions

• Take ownership of recurring creative tasks

• Potentially grow into a creative strategist or lead designer role

title: Reddit Community Marketing & AI Growth Specialist
description:
About the Role



Great Speech is seeking an experienced Reddit Community Marketing & AI Growth Specialist to expand our organic digital presence and help more individuals and families discover our virtual speech therapy services.



 We are looking for someone who already understands how to successfully market a healthcare or service-based organization through Reddit, online communities, search, and AI-driven marketing tools.



The ideal candidate understands Reddit culture and knows how to build authentic engagement without appearing promotional or spammy. You should also understand SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), AI search visibility, content marketing, and emerging AI marketing tools that can help Great Speech become more discoverable when consumers are searching for answers related to speech, language, communication, voice, fluency, and speech therapy services.



Healthcare marketing experience is strongly preferred. You should understand the importance of accuracy, sensitivity, privacy, and credibility when representing a healthcare organization online.



Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute an organic Reddit marketing and community engagement strategy for Great Speech.

Identify relevant subreddits, conversations, questions, and communities where Great Speech's expertise can provide genuine value.

Monitor Reddit for discussions related to speech therapy, speech delays, stuttering, articulation, autism, ADHD, voice, aphasia, communication challenges, online therapy, insurance coverage, and related topics.

Participate authentically in relevant conversations while following subreddit rules and avoiding spam or overly promotional content.

Identify opportunities to appropriately increase awareness of Great Speech and its virtual speech therapy services.

Develop strategies for building account credibility, karma, community trust, and long-term engagement.

title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — SHORT-TERM RENTAL OPERATIONS
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — SHORT-TERM RENTAL OPERATIONS (US VACATION RENTALS)



Full-time | Work from home | Must cover US business hours



ABOUT US



We're a US-based short-term / vacation rental management company operating several luxury properties (Airbnb, VRBO, and direct bookings via PMS such as Hospitable). Our homes are luxury and host celebrations — birthdays, bachelorettes, weddings, family reunions — so guest experience and attention to detail are everything. You'll be the operational backbone that keeps guest communication, vendor coordination, and property readiness running smoothly across multiple properties.



This is a long-term role for someone who wants to truly OWN operations, not just tick boxes. We invest heavily in training and documented processes (SOPs), and we're looking for someone who will use them, improve them, and grow with us.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Guest communication



Respond promptly and warmly to guest inquiries across Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking channels, in our established brand voice.

Handle booking inquiries, pre-approvals, house-rule questions, check-in/check-out logistics, and special requests — always following the SOP and confirming anything uncertain before replying.

Draft guest review responses, welcome/card messages, and post-stay direct-booking follow-ups.



Vendor & service coordination



Schedule and confirm weekly services: cleaning, inspection, pool, yard, pest control, propane, and one-off repairs — and follow up until each is confirmed, not just sent.

Serve as point of contact for cleaners, inspectors, and service providers; relay detailed, accurate instructions and collect the photos/confirmations we need.

Audit inspection and cleaning photos against our checklists, flag anything missing in real time, and get it corrected before the vendor leaves the property.



Supplies, inventory & purchasing



Place and track supply orders (Amazon, Uber Eats, Costco, etc.), confirm deliveries, and keep the inventory list accurate and up to date.

Troubleshoot ordering/delivery issues independently before escalating.



Finance & claims support



Track and confirm payments, process refunds, and prepare damage/claim reports for Airbnb/VRBO within claim and review windows.

Pay approved vendor invoices and keep records tidy.



Documentation & reporting



Maintain and update SOPs, FAQ tabs, guidebooks, and property files (Google Sheets, Docs, Slides/Canva).

Prepare clear reports for owner review on deadline.

Keep a written daily task list with EVERY action item logged — this is how we track and review work.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR (READ THIS CAREFULLY)



We've learned exactly what makes this role succeed or fail. If the points below sound like you, please apply.



You take ownership and never wait to be reminded. If a guest message comes in, a service needs confirming, or a task is due — you handle it without being chased.

You confirm before acting — you never guess. When you're unsure about a house rule, an instruction, or whether to move/discard/order something, you check the SOP first, and if it's not there, you ask before acting. Guessing has cost us bookings in the past. When in doubt, ask.

You are meticulous with details and instructions. You follow instructions exactly (quantities, placement, wording, timing), map photos and lists item-by-item, and catch discrepancies before they become guest problems.

You log every task and hit every deadline. You keep a written task list, add each item as it comes up, and deliver on time. If something can't be done on time, you flag it early with a clear reason.

You solve problems before escalating. When a tool won't cooperate or a vendor goes quiet, you investigate, try alternatives, and come with a proposed solution — not just "it's not working."

You communicate clearly, proactively, and in excellent written English. You give status updates as you progress, confirm understanding, and write guest-facing messages that are warm, polished, and error-free.

You're reliable and responsive during your shift — including urgent situations. Power outages, same-day turns, last-minute bookings, and guest issues happen. You stay reachable on Slack and WhatsApp during work hours and give timely heads-ups (within 30 minutes) when something needs attention.



REQUIREMENTS



Proven VA experience, ideally in short-term / vacation rental, property management, or hospitality (Airbnb/VRBO/Hospitable experience is a strong plus).

Excellent written and spoken English.

Comfortable with Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides), Slack, WhatsApp, and learning new tools (Hospitable, Airbnb/VRBO dashboards, Canva).

Strong organizational skills and a genuine eye for detail.

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a backup power/internet plan.

Able to work US business hours — [FILL IN your window, e.g. Pacific/Central morning coverage;
s/reservations reviewed by 8:30 AM PST on login days].



NICE TO HAVE



Experience handling damage claims/refunds on Airbnb or VRBO.

Basic bookkeeping / invoice tracking.

Canva or guidebook/presentation design experience.



HOW TO APPLY



We read applications closely — please follow these steps exactly (this is our first test of your attention to detail):



-Start your message with the word "WHITEDOVE" so we know you read the full post.

-In 3–4 sentences, tell us about a time you caught a mistake or prevented a problem before it reached a customer in a past role.

-List the property management / booking tools you've used and your typical availability in US time zones.

-Record a 60–90 second video (Loom or phone is fine) where you: (1) introduce yourself briefly, and (2) answer this out loud — "A guest messages at 9 PM asking if they can have 20 extra visitors over for a party tomorrow. You're not sure of the rule and the owner is offline. Walk me through exactly what you'd do." We're listening for clear English and how you think, not a perfect script.



Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed. We're excited to find someone great to grow with us long-term.

I run Precision Women's Care, an integrative practice where we help women get to the root of their health issues — PCOS, fertility, hormones, gut health, perimenopause — and feel like themselves again.



We're a small, close team, fully remote, and we care a great deal about the women who come to us.



Women find us, reach out, and genuinely want help — and then some of them quietly slip away because nobody followed up well enough. I'm looking for someone to own our front door: the leads, the phone, the follow-up, and the conversation that turns an interested woman into a patient.



This is a sales role, and it's also the first voice a woman hears from our practice. Both have to be true at once.



About the pay, before anything else. Your base is $7/hour, but this role is built so your income follows your results, not the clock. You earn a bonus on every patient and member you bring in, so $1,000+ a month is well within reach if you convert well. Do this properly and you should out-earn the hourly rate comfortably.



What you'll do

- Follow up quickly with every woman who reaches out, and guide her toward booking

- Have the real conversation: what we offer, what it costs, and what's holding her back

- Turn interested women into patients and members

- Keep following up with the ones who say "let me think about it" — this is where most of the value lives

- Answer and return calls on our practice phone during US hours

- Schedule patient follow-ups and make sure nothing sits unanswered



Who I'm looking for



Near-native English comes first, and it isn't negotiable. You'll be on the phone with American women talking about deeply personal things. You need to sound warm, natural, and completely at ease — able to hear hesitation in someone's voice and respond to it. Not scripted. Not stiff.



- You've actually sold something and closed it. Health, wellness, coaching, or memberships is a real plus

- You're comfortable with money. You can say a price out loud and then stay quiet

- You're warm, not pushy. Hard-closing will damage the trust our patients place in us

- You run yourself. You'll own the follow-up. Nobody will chase you

- You can work a consistent 4-hour block each weekday, on US Eastern time

- This role is open to women only. Our patients are women discussing fertility and hormones, and they've told us plainly that they're more comfortable speaking with another woman



The details

- Pay: $7/hour base, plus a bonus on every patient and member you bring in. A strong month lands around $1,000+ per month

- Hours: 20 per week to start — the same 4-hour block each weekday, US Eastern

- Growth: 4-week paid fellowship ? 3 months part-time ? full-time based on performance

- We provide: our practice phone system, Notion, and Toggl



How to apply

1. Application and voice recording: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a.

title: Vehicle Wrap Designer
description:
# Job Title: Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer



**Department:** Creative & Production



**Reports To:** Production Manager / Creative Director



**Job Type:** Full-Time



---



## Role Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical **Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer** to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Design & Concept Creation



* Design custom, high-resolution graphics for partial and full vehicle wraps, fleet vehicles, window vinyl, wall murals, dimensional signage, and banners.

* Utilize specialized vehicle templates (e.g., Pro Vehicle Outlines, Badie) to precisely position graphics across complex 3D vehicle body contours, body seams, door handles, and windows.

* Build realistic 2D and 3D photo mockups for client approvals to accurately represent the final installed product.

* Interpret client branding guidelines, logos, and briefs to create eye-catching visual concepts that align with the client’s marketing goals.



### Prepress & Production File Preparation



* Convert approved concepts into precision, print-ready vector/raster files scaled at full size (1:1) or accurate architectural scale (e.g., 1:10).

* Set up print files with appropriate bleeds, overlapping panels, tiling, overlap seam allowances, and vector contour cut lines (CutContour).

* Ensure correct color profiling (CMYK, Pantone/PMS matching) and image resolution settings to prevent pixelation on large-format outputs.

* Nest cut graphics and print files efficiently to minimize material waste during printing and cutting.





Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Qualifications & Skills



### Required



* **Experience:** 2–5+ years of proven graphic design experience specifically in the sign, large-format print, or vehicle wrap industry.

* **Software Proficiency:** Advanced mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (specifically **Adobe Illustrator** and **Adobe Photoshop**).

* **Technical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of vector graphics, raster resolution requirements (DPI vs. dimensions), scale calculations, and color theory (CMYK vs. RGB vs. Spot Colors).

* **Spatial Awareness:** Demonstrated ability to visualize flat 2D designs applied to complex 3D surfaces (curves, rivets, recessed panels).

* **Attention to Detail:** Meticulous approach to measurements, spell-checking, bleed allowances, and file organization.

* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills for presenting concepts to clients and technical handoffs to installers.

About Josi Health

Josi Health is a fast-growing, virtual-first healthcare company dedicated to making  neurodivergent care (including evaluations & therapy) faster, more accessible, and stress-free for families. We operate across 40+ states, navigating a complex landscape of commercial insurance carriers and state Medicaid programs. Because our clinical model is virtual-first, having bulletproof front-end patient access and benefit structures is critical to preventing administrative delays and billing denials.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-obsessed Eligibility, Benefits, & Prior Authorization Specialist who loves the investigative side of healthcare administration. In this role, you will not just perform data entry. You will act as an internal researcher and gatekeeper, digging into payor portals, insurance policy and benefits updates, and clinical guidelines to uncover the exact steps needed to secure prior authorizations and verify complex telehealth benefits.



This role is a blend of high-velocity queue management and deep-dive policy research. You will review incoming clinical orders, cross-reference them with payer requirements, clear daily scheduling queues, and build process playbooks where none exist. If you thrive on solving insurance puzzles, de-escalating complex scheduling bottlenecks, and keeping clinical schedules perfectly authorized, you will excel here.



Key Responsibilities



1. Insurance Verification & Telehealth Benefit Research

- Verify active patient insurance coverage, deductibles, co-pays, co-insurance, and coordination of benefits (COB) across commercial plans

- Conduct in-depth research on payer-specific policies regarding virtual care, remote developmental pediatrics, and psychological evaluations (CPT 90791, 96130, etc.)

2. Order Verification & Prior Authorization Management

- Review incoming clinical diagnostic referrals and orders to ensure demographic, insurance, CPT, and ICD-10 data are flawless

- Initiate, track, and validate prior authorizations through clearinghouses (e.g., Availity, Waystar), insurance portals, and phone escalations

3. Ambiguity Resolution & Playbook Creation

- Act as the go-to resource for clinical teams when a payer's prior-authorization process is vague, contradictory, or unmapped

- Validate conflicting information from multiple insurance sources to determine the most credible, risk-free path for claim submission

- Build, update, and maintain internal state-by-state reference guides on commercial insurance and state-by-state regulatory requirements



4. Clinic Coordination & Stakeholder Communication

- Prepare clear, professional patient insurance benefit letters outlining estimated out-of-pocket costs and referral requirements

- Collaborate closely with clinic coordinators and clinical staff to resolve last-minute scheduling exceptions or authorization gaps

- Help de-escalate patient or provider concerns regarding coverage limits with professional, empathetic communication



What We're Looking For



Must-Have

- 2+ years of healthcare clinic or startup experience specializing in insurance verification and prior authorizations

- Strong research capabilities: deep comfort navigating payor portals, digging through policy manuals, and calling payor representatives to clarify ambiguous rules

- Hands-on experience working with multiple major commercial payers (e.g., BCBS, Optum, Aetna)

- Working knowledge of medical terminology, CPT, ICD-10, and telehealth billing modifiers

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills: ability to translate technical insurance terms into simple, clear explanations

- High-speed internet, backup power setup, and the ability to work full-time during EST business hours



Preferred (Not Required)

- Medicaid familiarity is a plus

- Experience in virtual care, digital health, or behavioral/mental health environments

- Experience utilizing modern EHRs (e.g., Athenahealth) or CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

- Experience building internal SOPs or process documentation from scratch



What We Offer

- 100% remote work from anywhere outside the US

- Competitive monthly compensation in USD

- The opportunity to join a fast-growing, mission-driven team with clear professional growth

- Full access to modern operational tools and tech

1. Upload your resume (PDF)

2. Complete our qualification questionnaire

3. Submit

Manage multiple projects and revisions while meeting deadlines

Strong residential architectural drafting background

title: Performance Marketing / Paid Ads Manager
description:
This is not an entry-level role. 



I’m looking for an *experienced* paid advertising specialist to manage and grow top of funnel ads for a brand new funnel for an established online business and course.



I’m looking for someone with a demonstrated track record of profitably managing ad spend—not someone who will learn paid advertising with my budget.





Responsibilities

Paid Advertising

Develop and manage a paid advertising strategy, initially focused on Meta/Facebook and Instagram.

Create campaigns and ads, manage budgets, and continually optimize performance.

Build a systematic process for testing creative, hooks, copy, audiences, offers, and landing pages.

Manage prospecting and retargeting and identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns.

Recognize underperforming campaigns quickly and limit wasted spend.



Tracking & Reporting

Set up reliable tracking and attribution across the funnel.

Track the metrics that actually matter, including cost per lead, cost per qualified prospect/application, customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, revenue, and ROAS.

Establish our break-even acquisition costs so we know what we can profitably spend to acquire a customer.

Provide concise regular reporting that answers: What's working? What's not? Why? What are we doing next?



Creative Strategy

Turn existing content, testimonials, podcast material, and customer insights into advertising concepts.

Work with our social media assistant to identify high-performing organic content worth testing as ads.

Share winning hooks, messages, pain points, and creative with our social media assistant so paid and organic marketing continually inform one another.



What I'm Looking For

I am looking for someone with the experience to build out a tracking system for top of funnel ads for a new funnel. I am an established coach with an online course and high ticket offer, but having an evergreen funnel is new to me.  



I want someone who can help me distinguish between an ad problem, funnel problem, offer problem, or sales-conversion problem and recommend changes accordingly. 



I intend for this to be a long term, stable, part time position. I am building a team, not just offering a short term gig. The position will offer more hours at the beginning while the systems are being set up and campaigns are being tested, and then will transition to fewer hours on a performance-based monthly retainer.



To Apply

I'm much more interested in your results than your certifications. 



1) Please describe 2–3 examples of paid campaigns you personally managed. For each, briefly tell me:



What was being sold and at what price

Approximate monthly and total ad spend

Cost per lead and/or customer acquisition cost

ROAS or other primary profitability metric

What you personally handled

What you changed or tested that improved results



2) Also tell me about one campaign that didn't work. How quickly did you recognize the problem, how much was spent before you changed course, and what did you learn?



3) Write *ADS* at the beginning of your subject line when you apply.



I’m really excited to find someone who’s great at this and build a strong, long-term working relationship. If that might be you, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Outbound Membership Sales Rep — US HVAC Company (Night Shift, Warm Leads, Base + Commission)
description:
Outbound Membership Sales Representative



US HVAC Company | Night Shift | Warm Leads | Base Salary + Commission



Type of Work: Sales and Marketing, Telemarketing, Appointment Setting

Salary: $1,300 USD/month paid weekly at $325 + performance-based commission

Hours: 40 hours per week



About the Company



Strategic Heating & Air is a residential heating and air conditioning company based in Virginia, USA. We are looking for an experienced outbound sales representative to contact our existing customers and help them enroll in our annual Preventative Maintenance Plan.



This is not a cold calling position. You will be speaking with customers who have already worked with us, either by having their HVAC system serviced or by purchasing equipment from our company. They already know our name, and many of them are familiar with our services.



Your role will be to explain the benefits of the maintenance plan, answer questions, and help customers d
 if it is the right fit for them.



What You Will Do



Your daily responsibilities will include:



Calling existing customers from our company database using our US phone system. We provide the software, and customers will see our Virginia phone number when you call.

Explaining our Preventative Maintenance Plan, including what is included, the price, and how it helps protect their HVAC system.

Helping customers enroll in the plan and securely collecting payment information over the phone.

Scheduling their first maintenance visit while you are speaking with them.

Contacting current members when their plans are about to expire and helping them renew.

Reaching out to former members who canceled or allowed their plan to expire and trying to win them back.

Keeping detailed and accurate notes for every call, including outcomes and customer information, inside ServiceTitan.

Sending a short summary of your activities at the end of each shift.

Requirements



We are looking for someone who has:



Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent that is easy for American homeowners, especially older customers, to understand over the phone. This is our most important requirement. A voice recording will be required during the application process.

At least 2 years of experience with outbound calls to US customers. Experience in telemarketing, appointment setting, inside sales, collections, or customer retention is acceptable.

Confidence asking for the sale and handling rejection professionally.

The ability to follow scripts, processes, and compliance requirements carefully.

A fast and reliable internet connection with at least 15 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload speed. A wired connection is strongly preferred.

A quiet and private workspace with no background noise, traffic, pets, or interruptions.

Backup power and backup internet. We need you to have a plan in case of outages.

A noise-canceling USB headset. Bluetooth earbuds are not acceptable.

A computer that can run browser-based software smoothly.

Preferred Experience (Not Required)



It is a plus if you have experience with:



ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, or similar field service software.

HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pest control, lawn care, or other home service industries.

Selling memberships, subscriptions, service agreements, or recurring services.

Working Hours



Please read this carefully before applying.



This position follows US Eastern Time business hours, which means you will work overnight hours in the Philippines.



Schedule:

9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday through Friday



The schedule changes slightly twice a year when the US adjusts its clocks.



These hours cannot be changed because you will be calling American homeowners during their daytime hours.



If you cannot commit to a permanent night shift, please do not apply.



Compensation

Base salary: $1,300 USD per month, paid weekly through Wise.

Commission:

$10 USD for each new annual maintenance plan sold.

$7 USD for each successful renewal.

Commission is paid after the customer's payment has cleared and the sale has been properly entered into our system.

Performance review after 90 days.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not a short-term job. Strong performers will have opportunities to grow into leadership roles as we expand our sales team.



How to Apply



Please follow these steps exactly. Applications that skip steps will not be reviewed.



Start your application message with the word BLUEBIRD so we know you read the entire posting.

In 3 to 4 sentences, tell us about the most challenging outbound calling job you have had and include your results or performance numbers.

Record a voice sample and send us the link. Google Drive, Dropbox, Loom, or Vocaroo are all acceptable.



Read the following naturally, as if you were speaking with a real customer:



"Good afternoon, my name is [YOUR NAME] and I'm calling on behalf of Strategic Heating and Air. I'm reaching out because our records show we serviced your heating and cooling system last year, and I wanted to tell you about our maintenance plan. It's designed to keep your system running efficiently, catch small problems before they turn into expensive repairs, and it includes two tune-up visits a year plus priority scheduling. Do you have two minutes for me to walk you through it?"



In the same recording, answer this question in your own words:



A customer says: "I'm not interested, I already have someone who does my maintenance." What would you say next?



Confirm that you can work from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time permanently.

Tell us your internet speed and confirm whether you have backup power and backup internet.



Skills Required: English, Telemarketing, Appointment Setting, Sales, Outbound Sales, Customer Service

Preferred Skill: ServiceTitan experience

Video Editor — Short-Form, Commercial & Long-Form



Company: Odd Sox



Odd Sox is expanding our video editing team and looking for talented editors across several editing styles.



Our highest priority is finding a strong Short-Form / Social Video Editor who can work with us consistently on daily content. We are also interested in building relationships with editors who specialize in commercial/branded content and long-form storytelling.



You do not need to specialize in every category.



When applying, tell us which editing category best represents your strongest work.



EDITOR TYPES WE’RE LOOKING FOR



1. Short-Form / Social Video Editor — HIGHEST PRIORITY



This is our primary need and is intended to become a consistent, full-time editing position.



You’ll work on content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social channels.



We’re looking for someone who understands:



* Strong hooks and opening seconds

* Fast, intentional pacing

* Music and sound design

* Captions and on-screen graphics

* Comedy and timing

* Social-first storytelling

* Retention-focused editing

* Current editing styles and trends

* Turning raw ideas into entertaining short-form content

* Creating multiple pieces of content consistently



We have videos that need to be edited daily, so consistency, communication, organization, and reliability are extremely important.



2. Commercial / Branded Content Editor



We’re also looking for editors capable of producing polished campaign and commercial work.



This may include:



* Brand commercials

* Product campaigns

* Collaboration launches

* Lifestyle videos

* Hero campaign films

* Event recaps

* Cinematic branded content

* Social campaign cutdowns



Strong storytelling, pacing, music selection, sound design, visual polish, and attention to brand/product details are important.



These projects may be assigned on a freelance/project basis.



3. Long-Form / Podcast / Documentary Editor



We’re also interested in editors who specialize in longer-form storytelling.



Projects may include:



* Podcasts

* Interviews

* Behind-the-scenes content

* Mini-documentaries

* YouTube content

* Brand stories

* Long-form campaign content



We’re looking for editors who understand how to build a story, maintain pacing, identify strong moments, and keep longer content engaging.



These projects may be assigned on a freelance/project basis.



HOW OUR WORKFLOW WORKS



Our goal is to give editors everything they need to succeed.



Projects will be organized before they are assigned, including footage, assets, references, project information, and creative direction.



We’re looking for editors who are excellent at following creative direction while still bringing their own ideas to the edit.



If you see an opportunity to improve pacing, storytelling, music, sound design, transitions, graphics, or the overall video, we want you to bring those ideas forward.



We don’t want someone who simply follows instructions mechanically. We want editors who understand the direction and then use their editing ability to make the final video even better.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Strong editing portfolio

* Excellent sense of pacing and storytelling

* Strong music selection and sound design

* Attention to detail

* Ability to follow references and creative direction

* Ability to contribute creative ideas

* Reliable communication

* Ability to meet agreed-upon deadlines

* Comfortable receiving and completing revisions

* Consistent quality across projects

* Experience with branded, social, entertainment, fashion, lifestyle, sports, or consumer-product content is a plus



We do not require a specific editing program. Use the professional software that allows you to produce your best work.



TURNAROUND



When applying, please tell us your typical turnaround time for the type of editing you’re applying for.



We care about speed, but quality and reliability are equally important.



HOW TO APPLY



Your application subject line MUST include the editing category you’re applying for:



SHORT-FORM EDITOR — [Your Name]



COMMERCIAL EDITOR — [Your Name]



or



LONG-FORM EDITOR — [Your Name]



If you’re strong in multiple categories, you can list multiple categories.

* Your portfolio / editing reel

* Links to 3–5 examples that best represent the category you’re applying for

* Your strongest editing specialty

* Your typical turnaround time

* Your current availability

* Your preferred rate / compensation expectations



Please do not send only a general portfolio with dozens of unrelated videos. Show us the work that best represents what you can bring to Odd Sox.



SHORT-FORM EDITOR TEST



After portfolio review, selected Short-Form Editor candidates will be invited to complete a short editing assessment before a final hiring decision.



The assessment will consist of creating a 30-second test edit using footage and direction provided by Odd Sox.



The test is for evaluation purposes only and will not be used or published commercially.



Only candidates whose portfolios have already passed our initial review will be invited to complete the test.



GET TO KNOW ODD SOX



Before applying, take some time to familiarize yourself with our brand, products, collaborations, and content.



Website: 



Instagram : 
/oddsoxofficial 



We’re looking for editors who can understand the Odd Sox identity while helping us continue to elevate the quality of our video content.

title: Marketing Technology & Mixpanel Specialist
description:

marketing analytics infrastructure that powers data-driven growth. This role is ideal for someone

with strong MarTech and growth marketing experience who has hands-on expertise configuring

Mixpanel, developing event taxonomies, building conversion funnels, and translating marketing

data into actionable insights.



This is not a traditional engineering or analytics role. We're looking for someone who

understands marketing technology and knows how to connect customer behavior, acquisition

data, and marketing performance. You'll help build Mixpanel from the ground up, establish

reliable event tracking and reporting, and ensure marketing and advertising data can be

accurately interpreted across the customer journey.



We are always looking for enthusiastic, problem-solving personalities. Fluent English and

exceptional teamwork skills are required for all of our positions. Please submit your resume or

any documentation in English. We can't wait to meet you!



Qualifications

● Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal (C1 level Minimum).

● Enthusiastic, positive attitude, eager to work with others and solve problems.

● Hands-on experience configuring and implementing Mixpanel, including event tracking,

event properties, segmentation, and funnels.

● Demonstrated experience building an e-commerce event taxonomy and implementing

analytics tracking from the ground up.

● Strong MarTech and marketing technology experience with an understanding of how

marketing systems connect across the customer journey.

● Experience building marketing analytics reports using UTM parameters, acquisition

sources, and customer segmentation.

connect marketing activity to downstream conversion.

advertising or marketing platforms.

independently.

Manager, or similar tools is preferred.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — slow living content
description:
Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — slow living content



About the channel

a personal lifestyle and creative YouTube channel centered around the art of becoming — slowly building while documenting: slow living, personal essays, creativity

Visual/editing references include creators such as 
 , Emily 
 Life of Riza and cinematic slow-living and personal lifestyle creators.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Role



I am looking for a Long-Form YouTube Video Editor to help shape raw footage into intimate, story-driven videos

I’m looking for an editor who understand the emotional story underneath ordinary moments and use pacing, shot selection, music, silence, natural sound and visual juxtaposition (contrasting shots showing opposite theme/emotion) to bring the story forward.

The ideal editor understands that slow-paced does not mean emotionally flat. A quiet video should still have rhythm, progression, contrast, tension, release and payoff.



----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Responsibilities

Story & Rough Cut

• Review and organize raw footage and identify the strongest takes, moments and visual details.

• Build rough cuts around the story and emotional progression of each video rather than simply arranging footage chronologically.

• Identify natural story beats, including setup, tension, progression, reflection, payoff and resolution.

• Recognize small candid moments — a facial expression, laugh, mistake, pause, dance, room sound or mundane detail — that add personality and emotional meaning.

• Remove repetitive or unnecessary footage while preserving the relaxed pacing that defines the channel.





Fine Cut & Pacing (Retention)

• Refine cuts for strong viewer engagement without turning the content into hyperactive short-form editing.

• Create rhythm through variations in shot length, framing, movement, sound and music.

• Understand how to intentionally use longer takes, pauses and silence.

• Use J-cuts, L-cuts, match cuts, sound bridges and other subtle techniques to create fluid transitions between scenes.

• Build emotional payoff across sequences rather than treating every clip as equally important.

• Maintain attention through storytelling and emotional curiosity, not unnecessary effects or constant cuts.



Sound Design & Music

• Preserve and enhance natural sounds such as footsteps, cooking, typing, packaging, dishes, writing, fabric, room tone and environmental ambience.

• Create immersive ASMR-style moments where appropriate.

• Use music intentionally rather than placing continuous background music underneath the entire video.

• [Songs for each video will be provided] (Epidemic sounds) 

• Know when music should enter, build, disappear or give way to natural sound.

• Cut to musical phrases and emotional changes rather than mechanically cutting on every beat.

• Create clean and balanced dialogue, music and ambient sound levels.



Visual Style

• Maintain a warm, intimate, cinematic and slightly imperfect visual language.

• Prioritize natural moments over overly polished “influencer” footage.

• Perform basic color correction and create consistent color across footage from different cameras and lighting environments.

• Use typography, graphics and overlays consistent with visual identity [Will be provided] 

• No zoom, meme editing, excessive sound effects, constant text or overly aggressive retention editing are necessary





Workflow & Collaboration



• IMPORTANT: You will be collaborating directly with me on every project. It will be hands-on at first to develop understanding and shared editing style. If this is not your style of work, please don’t apply. 

• Work from organized footage, creative briefs, references and editor notes provided for each video.

• Maintain organized project files, timelines, assets and media.

• Submit drafts for review and implement timestamped feedback efficiently.

• Communicate proactively when footage, creative direction or technical information is missing.

Develop an increasingly strong understanding of the personal brand’s editing language so that less detailed direction is required over time.

Help improve the editing workflow as the channel and production volume grow.





----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Requirements

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro & Da Vinci Resolve preferred.

• Experience editing long-form YouTube content.

• Comfortable working with 4K footage and proxy workflows.

• Reliable computer, storage and internet setup capable of handling long-form projects.

• An understanding of YouTube retention without treating retention as “make a cut every two seconds.”



Long-term, I want to build a creative partnership with an editor who understands the channel deeply enough to contribute ideas and make strong editorial decisions independently. 







----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Content Examples

The channel will primarily include three types of long-form videos:

1. Lifestyle / Slow-Living Vlogs

Observational videos documenting everyday life, home, food, routines, creativity and the process of building a meaningful life.

2. Personal Essays / Talking-Head Videos

Thoughtful conversations around self-trust, identity, creativity, perfectionism, manifestation, journaling, emotional regulation, ambition and becoming the person you want to be — supported by cinematic B-roll from everyday life.

3. Creative / Project Videos

Nail art, home projects, decorating, making things and other creative pursuits, told through the same intimate storytelling language.



To Apply

Please fill out this form: 



2–4 long-form videos you have personally edited, preferably lifestyle, cinematic, documentary, vlog or personal-essay work.

Please do not send only short-form TikToks/Reels. I am specifically looking for evidence of long-form storytelling and pacing ability.





A paid trial edit may be requested before beginning an ongoing collaboration.

title: VIDEO EDITOR, SHORT-FORM REELS (Remote · PHP & SA)
description:
WHO WE ARE

We're a small creator-management agency (Portugal HQ) that builds handmade brands for a tiny roster of creators. The founder works on every account. We're hiring our first dedicated editor for one flagship creator: a cozy homemaker lifestyle brand (warm home, garden, cooking, comfort) with a retro-gaming thread woven through it.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY EDIT

Instagram Reels (15 to 30s) for a warm domestic-lifestyle brand. Think lamp-lit rooms, cooking and garden moments, soft-spoken voiceover, a retro game paused on the TV in the background. Warm and cozy, but never slow or boring. Our editing style:



- 2-3s pacing rule - Something must happen every 2 to 3 seconds: a sound effect, a subtle zoom, a cut, a text pop, an on-screen detail. Micro-events keep retention high. The trick is doing this while the reel still FEELS calm and warm, not chaotic. Gentle movement, not zoom-punch spam.

- Optimal trimming - Tight cuts, no dead air, no wasted frames. Every clip trimmed to its best moment.

- Sound design as a core skill - Domestic texture (kettle, chopping, rain on the window, keyboard clicks) layered with retro game SFX accents and a whisper-register voice. You'll integrate sound effects constantly. Our audience recognizes the brand by sound in 3 seconds.

- Simple, clean transitions and effects - Smooth and purposeful. No flashy transition packs, no trend-chasing effects that fight the cozy vibe.

- Nostalgia-literate accents - You don't need to be a Nintendo expert. You'll work from our reference bank of era-correct sounds and visuals, and you'll learn why a 1998 chest-opening sound outperforms any trending audio for our audience.



You'll get a full style bible, hook templates, banned-elements list, and direct feedback from the founder. We want an editor who becomes THE voice of this brand's edit, not a gig-worker juggling 30 clients.





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Some experience with short-form vertical content (Reels, Shorts, TikTok). Show us, don't tell us.

title: B2B Lead Research & Data Scraping Specialist (LinkedIn / Apollo / PhantomBuster) — German Market
description:
B2B Lead Research & Data Scraping Specialist (LinkedIn / Apollo / PhantomBuster) — German Market



**Job Type:** Full-time (40 hrs/week), 100% remote

**Salary:** $500 – $750/month (based on experience) + performance bonus per 1,000 validated leads delivered above target

**Working hours:** Flexible, but 3–4 hours overlap with European time (CET) required



---



## About the role



We are a German B2B lead generation agency. We run cold
 and cold calling campaigns for our clients in Germany — and everything starts with clean, accurate lead data.



We are looking for one person who owns our entire lead sourcing operation: you receive a clearly defined ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) from us, and you deliver validated, structured lead lists — every week, reliably, at volume.



This is **not** a sales role. You will not write
s, you will not call anyone. Your job is data: find it, verify it, clean it, deliver it.



---



## What you will deliver every month



- **~10,000 validated B2B
 addresses** (bounce-checked, deduplicated, ICP-matched)

- **~1,500 – 2,000 phone numbers** for our cold calling team. A working, verified company phone number is enough — a direct dial is a bonus, not a requirement. What matters is that the number is correct and tied to a named contact person or a clearly identified company.

- All leads delivered in **our fixed Google Sheets / CSV column schema** (company, domain, contact first/last name, job title,
, phone, city, source, verification status, date)

- Weekly delivery batches — not one dump at the end of the month



Targets are volume **and** quality. A list of 10,000
s that doesn't match the ICP is worth zero to us.



---



## What you will actually do



- Build search queries and filters in LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 
, and Google Maps based on the ICP we define

- Run and maintain scraping workflows (PhantomBuster, Waalaxy, Apollo exports, Google Maps scrapers, Instant Data Scraper, etc.)

- Enrich missing data — find the decision maker's
 and phone via company websites, Impressum pages, Xing, LinkedIn, and enrichment tools

- Verify every
 through our verification tool (MillionVerifier / NeverBounce) — we only accept "valid", never "catch-all" or "risky" without flagging it

- Deduplicate against our master suppression list before every delivery

- Spot-check ICP fit manually: does this company actually match what we asked for?

- Report weekly: how many leads, from which source, verification rate, blockers



---



## Requirements



- **Proven experience** scraping and enriching B2B leads at volume — you have done thousands of leads per month before, not 200

- Hands-on with at least three of: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 
, PhantomBuster, Waalaxy, Surfe, Clay, Instant Data Scraper, Google Maps scrapers

- Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills (filters, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, deduplication, text functions, basic data cleaning)

- Understanding of
 verification and why bounce rates matter

- Extremely detail-oriented — you notice when a column is shifted, when names are in the wrong case, when a domain is a Gmail address

- Reliable internet connection and a computer that can run multiple browser tabs and tools

- Good written English for reporting and communication



**German is NOT required.** But you must be comfortable working on German-language websites (use a translator — you mainly need to find Impressum, Kontakt, and Team pages).



## Nice to have



- Experience with the German or wider European market

- Experience with LinkedIn account management / avoiding restrictions and bans

- Familiarity with 
, n8n, or Zapier to automate parts of the workflow

- Basic understanding of GDPR-compliant B2B data handling



---



## What we provide



- **All tools and paid accounts** — LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, PhantomBuster, verification credits, proxies. You never pay for software.

- A clearly defined ICP for every campaign, with examples of good and bad fits

- Our exact column schema and delivery process

- Direct communication with the founder — no bureaucracy, fast decisions



---



## How we hire



1. **Application** (see below)

2. **Short interview** (video call, ~20 minutes)

3. **Paid test task:** source 100 leads for a real ICP we give you. We pay for this regardless of outcome.

4. **Offer**



---



## How to apply



Please send us:



1. Start your message with the word **"SCRAPER-2026"** so we know you read the full posting. Applications without this will be ignored.

2. Which of the tools listed above you have personally used, and for how long

3. The **largest lead list you have ever built** — how many leads, in what timeframe, for which market, and how you sourced them

4. A short answer: *You need 500 direct phone numbers of managing directors of small German companies. Apollo only returns the company main line. What do you do?*

5. Your monthly salary expectation in USD



We reply to every application that follows these steps.

How we work:



For every product you receive a complete frame: specs, impact scores from real review data, target sell price and target FOB. - Product research and selection — the founder hands you a complete brief.

- Fast and excellent — quick without losing precision.

- Signal over noise: asks everything that matters, reports back concise and decision-ready.

- Direct line to the founder: short lines, fast decisions, real ownership.

- AI-first workflow: complete briefs, automated documentation, no busywork.



How to apply



No cover letters. Apply by
 to 
 — not through the platform inbox. Your
 must contain:
