title: Virtual Assistant – Cold Calling
description:
Cold Caller





***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********



You will fail the application process if you don't read the entire job description.



***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********

***********MAKE SURE YOU READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION********





We are looking for a reliable and conversational cold caller to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls daily, following a basic process and script, and consistently completing daily outreach tasks. This is an entry-level position that is eligible for growth.





About Us



Started in 2017 and we're growing like crazy.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2025 and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2026.

A small team of 1 American and 10 Filipinos.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

100% inbound leads from Organic Search (SEO).

No competition - in 90% of the markets we serve, we have no competitors. Because of this, our sales are pretty easy to make.





Compensation and Benefits

Compensation:

$4 per hour

Benefits to be provided after completion of 3 months:

Health Insurance



Type of Employment

Full Time

40 hours per week

Schedule - 9 AM to 5 PM EST





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job.

We do NOT expect you to have any prior sales experience.

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you.

We will train you on how to take customers through the sales process.

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Cold Caller, Remote Cold Caller, Cold Caller / Appointment Setter, B2B Cold Caller, Outbound Sales Representative, Outbound Appointment Setter, Sales Appointment Setter, Telemarketing Representative, Telesales Representative, Lead Generation Specialist, Sales Development Representative, SDR, Business Development Representative, BDR, Outbound Call Center Agent, Virtual Assistant – Cold Calling, Phone Sales Representative





Duties and Responsibilities

Make a high volume of outbound calls each day to businesses.

Follow call scripts, workflows, and basic procedures.

Log call outcomes and notes accurately.

Send follow-up
s and text messages when necessary.

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINKELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Identify decision-makers and schedule callbacks or appointments.

Communicate feedback and common objections to the team.



Requirements

Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or a similar outbound sales role.

Experience making a large number of calls daily.

Ability to follow a defined process and use scripts effectively.

Strong conversational and listening skills.

Comfortable handling rejection and maintaining a positive attitude.

Excellent spoken English and clear communication skills.

Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience calling businesses or working in B2B sales.

Familiarity with CRMs and dialing software.

Experience working remotely.







What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINKELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.





How to apply: Please click on the link: 
/work-opportunities/cold-caller

title: Strategic Executive Assistant (Creative, Organized & High Ownership)
description:
Who We Are:

We are CL Financial (CLFIN . ca), a Toronto-based financial services firm serving families across Ontario and Alberta, with a strong presence in the Filipino community in Canada. We've been around since 2012 and are now in an exciting stage of growth: building new technology, training programs, internal systems, and infrastructure to support where the company is going next.



We're a lean team with ambitious plans, and we care about doing things well: clean systems, clear communication, strong design, and thoughtful execution.



We're not trying to become a huge corporate machine. We want to stay lean, move quickly, and have really capable people doing meaningful work.



About the Role:

We're looking for a Strategic Executive Assistant to work closely with our COO across creative, operational, and strategic projects.



This isn't a traditional VA role where you'll simply be handed a checklist every morning and told what to do. Sometimes you'll get a clear assignment. Other times, you'll get a rough idea, a voice note, or a half-formed concept and need to help turn it into something useful, organized, and polished. That's a big part of the job.



This will start as a part-time role, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position after the first few months if it's a strong mutual fit. Ideally, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



One other thing, you don't need to come from finance, although you should be interested in learning it. This is an industry where expertise matters, and the better you understand our business, our advisors, and our clients, the better you'll become at this role. We'll help you learn, but you should genuinely want to.



What You'll Do:

Project Support:

- Organize projects, priorities, meetings, and follow-ups

- Coordinate with team members, contractors, and developers

- Help make sure things don't quietly fall through the cracks



Creative & Communication:

- Create beautifully designed presentations, one-pagers, training materials, internal communications, and visual assets

- Turn rough notes or concepts into polished outputs

- Help maintain consistency across our brand and internal tools

- Look at something we've created and tell us, honestly, "this could be better"



Systems & Operations:

- Maintain daily spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards, and project pipelines

- Test new internal tools and identify improvements

- Find ways to simplify or automate repetitive work



AI & Technology:

- Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, and Google Workspace to research, create, and improve work

- Experiment with new tools and figure things out quickly

- Help us find smarter ways to work as new technology becomes available



You don't need to know every tool already. Being resourceful and learning quickly matters much more.



Who We're Looking For:

You'll probably thrive here if you:

- Have excellent written English

- Are highly organized and dependable

- Have strong visual/design taste (this is more important than I'm probably letting on in this posting)

- Can work independently without needing constant direction

- Learn new tools quickly

- Can manage multiple projects without losing the details

- Are comfortable receiving direct feedback

- Naturally look for better ways to do things

- Have high integrity and are comfortable being transparent (this is also more important than I’m probably letting on in this posting)



Above everything else, we're looking for judgment, initiative, and ownership. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think, ask good questions, and care about getting to the right outcome.



Why Work With Us?

- Direct exposure to company leadership and decision-making

- Meaningful projects alongside the more traditional VA work

- Creative freedom; good ideas are genuinely encouraged

- Opportunity to learn AI, technology, operations, and business

- Increasing responsibility as your capabilities grow

- A real pathway from part-time into a full-time role

- A stable company with ambitious long-term growth plans

- A predominantly Filipino team and client community (99% of the company and clients come from a Filipino background)

- The chance to actually see your work shape how a company operates (for real)



How to Apply:

If you've made it this far, include the word "builder" somewhere in the first sentence of your application so we know you actually read the posting.



Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Why this role caught your attention

3. Your answer to this question: What does the best boss you've ever worked with do that brings out your best work? And what does a manager do that makes it harder for you to perform?



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone smart, creative, trustworthy, and hungry to become exceptionally good at what they do. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Assistant – build our go high level
description:
Virtual Assistant / GoHighLevel CRM, Automation & Integrations Specialist



About the Role



I am the founder of TruPay Inc. and several growing businesses. I am looking for an exceptional part-time Virtual Assistant who is highly skilled in GoHighLevel (GHL), CRM management, automation, webhooks, integrations, telephony, and business operations.



This is not a basic data-entry VA position.



I need someone who can help me build, organize, automate, integrate, and continuously improve our GoHighLevel system while also assisting with day-to-day business operations.



A major part of this role will involve helping us connect and maintain a custom dialer that integrates directly with GoHighLevel, so strong technical knowledge of webhooks, APIs, workflow triggers, contact synchronization, call activity, and GHL's web phone/telephony features is extremely important.



You will work directly with me to build and manage multiple pipelines for different processes and businesses, create workflows, organize incoming information, maintain records, improve automations, troubleshoot integrations, and help make our overall operation more efficient.



You do not need experience in our industry. I care much more about your ability to build systems, understand integrations, solve problems, learn quickly, and use GoHighLevel at an advanced level.



The position starts at approximately 10–20 hours per week. As the businesses grow, hours, responsibility, compensation, and opportunities for advancement can increase.



Compensation



- Starting base pay: $1.75–$2.00 per hour

- Approximately 10–20 hours per week to start

- Performance-based raises

- Additional bonuses and earning opportunities based on results

- Opportunity to grow into a larger operations, integrations, or management role



Your Core Responsibilities



1. GoHighLevel CRM



You should be genuinely experienced with GoHighLevel, not someone who has simply used it occasionally.



You will help us build and continuously improve our GHL environment.



CRM & Pipeline Management



- Build and organize multiple pipelines

- Create custom stages for different processes

- Create custom fields

- Create tags

- Create smart lists

- Organize contacts and records

- Build systems for different contact and lead types

- Create automated processes for different pipelines

- Maintain clean CRM data

- Prevent duplicate or disorganized records

- Make sure information enters the correct pipeline

- Identify and fix problems with CRM organization

- Help develop a scalable CRM structure across multiple businesses



2. Advanced GHL Workflows & Automations



Build, maintain, and troubleshoot automations involving:



- Form submissions

- Contact creation and updates

- Pipeline movement

- Opportunity creation

- Automatic assignment

- Internal notifications

-
 automation

- SMS automation

- Appointment reminders

- Task creation

- Follow-up sequences

- Long-term nurture workflows

- Trigger links

- Webhooks

- Forms and surveys

- Calendar automations

- Conditional logic

- If/else branches

- Workflow goals

- Tags and custom fields

- Automated record organization



You should understand how to create automation from beginning to end, not simply edit workflows someone else created.



3. Webhooks, APIs & Custom Integrations — REQUIRED



This is an important part of the position.



We are building a custom dialer that will connect directly into GoHighLevel, and you will help us test, organize, troubleshoot, and improve the connection between the systems.



You should have strong practical experience with webhooks and understand how information moves between different software platforms.



You should be comfortable with:



- Incoming webhooks

- Outgoing webhooks

- HTTP requests

- POST requests

- GET requests

- JSON payloads

- Request headers

- Authentication tokens

- API keys

- Webhook URLs

- Trigger events

- Contact IDs

- Opportunity IDs

- Custom fields

- Data mapping

- Field mapping

- Error responses

- Webhook testing

- Duplicate prevention

- Retry logic

- Troubleshooting failed automations

- Reading logs

- Testing integrations

- Connecting third-party applications to GHL



You do not necessarily need to be a software developer, but you must understand webhooks well enough to work confidently with developers and troubleshoot integrations yourself.



Dialer Integration



Our custom dialer will communicate directly with GoHighLevel.



You may help configure and test processes such as:



- Sending contacts from GHL to the dialer

- Sending dialer activity back into GHL

- Updating contact records after calls

- Updating custom fields

- Updating pipeline stages

- Triggering workflows after calls

- Recording call outcomes

- Logging dispositions

- Creating follow-up tasks

- Assigning records

- Syncing contact information

- Triggering automations based on call results

- Preventing duplicate contact creation

- Making sure activity is associated with the correct GHL contact

- Troubleshooting failed webhook events

- Testing new dialer features before they are released to the team



You should be comfortable looking at a webhook payload and understanding what data is being sent, where it is going, and why something may have failed.



4. GHL Web Phone & Telephony — REQUIRED



You must also be highly comfortable using and troubleshooting the GoHighLevel web phone and calling system.



You should understand how calling works inside GHL and be able to help team members use it correctly.



Experience should include areas such as:

title: Operations and Dispatch Manager
description:
We're looking for an **Operations Manager** to run the day-to-day operations of a growing home services company specializing in garage door installation and repair. You will be the owner's second-in-command, managing technician schedules, handling customer communications, preparing estimates, processing payments, and keeping the business running smoothly from end to end.



This is a high-responsibility, customer-facing role. You will be the first voice many customers hear, the person coordinating field technicians in real time, and the one making sure every job is scheduled, followed up on, and closed out correctly. If you are organized, outgoing, genuinely great with people, and comfortable owning operations without being micromanaged, this role is a strong fit.



## Why You'll Want to Join



- You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

- **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy

- Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines

- **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive

- This role requires availability during **US business hours**

- Operate as the owner's right hand with direct influence over how the business runs day to day

- Join a growing home services company with a strong local reputation and a clear path to scale



## What You'll Work On



**Scheduling and Dispatch**



- Schedule customer appointments and dispatch technicians based on location, availability, and job type

- Manage daily technician schedules and adjust in real time as jobs are completed, delayed, or added

- Coordinate with field technicians throughout the day to ensure jobs are running on time and customers are informed



**Customer Communication**



- Answer inbound customer calls and serve as backup support during high call volume periods

- Communicate professionally and warmly with customers from first contact through job completion

- Resolve customer issues, complaints, and follow-up requests with a solutions-first approach



**Sales and Estimates**



- Prepare estimates and quotes based on job requirements and pricing guidelines

- Follow up on open sales opportunities and convert inquiries into booked appointments

- Support the owner in closing jobs and maintaining a healthy conversion rate on inbound leads



**Invoicing and Payments**



- Create invoices and process customer payments accurately and on time

- Maintain clean financial records and flag discrepancies or outstanding balances



**CRM and Administrative Management**



- Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records in Jobber or a similar CRM

- Keep job notes, schedules, and customer history organized and accessible

- Assist with general administrative and operational tasks as the business grows



## What You Bring



- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills with a warm, professional, and confident phone presence

- Experience in dispatching, scheduling, or operations management in a service-based business

- Home services industry experience in garage doors, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or similar trades is strongly preferred

- Proficiency with CRM platforms; Jobber experience is a strong plus

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and real-time schedule changes simultaneously

- Comfortable speaking with customers, handling objections, and following up on sales opportunities

- Proactive, dependable, and self-directed with the ability to own operations without constant oversight

- Genuine interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust quickly with both customers and field technicians



## Nice to Have



- Prior experience as an operations manager, office manager, or dispatcher in a home services company

- Familiarity with Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, or similar field service management platforms

- Experience handling customer escalations and resolving service complaints professionally

- Background supporting a small business owner or serving as a second-in-command in a lean team environment



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your **updated resume**

2. A **short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes)** introducing yourself, describing your experience in operations or dispatching, and giving an example of how you handled a scheduling conflict or customer issue under pressure



**Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.**



If you are organized, people-oriented, and want to be the operational backbone of a growing home services business with real ownership and direct impact, this role gives you the responsibility and the trust to do your best work.

We are looking for international talent with a scientific profile, strong learning ability, and motivation to join a growing company and contribute to real projects involving technical analysis, product validation, scientific support, and applied communication.



Position Objective



We are seeking a Scientific Specialist in Plant Biotechnology or related fields to support the technical work of the Plant Biotechnology Laboratory. The selected person will participate in product performance testing, comparative analysis of reagents and supplies, technical report writing, creation of educational audiovisual material, and customer-oriented technical support.

Extensive previous professional experience is not mandatory. We especially value scientific training, discipline, analytical thinking, academic or extracurricular achievements, clear communication, and the ability to quickly learn new methodologies, programs, and tools, including artificial intelligence tools applied to scientific and documentation work.

- Write technical reports on results, product differences, advantages, limitations, and possible applications.

- Support activities of the Plant Biotechnology Laboratory related to phytopathology, molecular biology, plant biotechnology, and related areas.

- Document tests and procedures through videos, photographs, guides, or audiovisual material that can serve as technical evidence and educational content for clients.

- Prepare explanatory material for technical training, product demonstrations, and post-sale support.

- Provide continuous technical support, helping answer client questions regarding product use, performance, and applications.

- Coordinate with the General Manager, Human Resources area, and technical team to align scientific activities with company objectives.

- Use digital and artificial intelligence tools to improve document review, technical analysis, report writing, and production of support materials.



Recommended Academic Background

We’re seeking candidates from the following or related areas:



- Biotechnology Engineering

- Plant Biotechnology

- Agronomy

- Biochemistry

- Molecular Biology

- Phytopathology

- Microbiology

- Biology

- Agricultural sciences or related scientific fields



Valued Knowledge



- Phytopathology.

- Molecular biology.

- Plant biotechnology.

- Basic laboratory work.

- Interpretation of technical sheets, protocols, and scientific documentation.

- Technical report writing.

- Scientific communication and preparation of educational material.

- Use of digital tools, spreadsheets, analysis tools, and artificial intelligence tools.



Required Profile



- Good level of English.

- Strong motivation for applied scientific work and continuous learning.

- Analytical ability to compare products, interpret technical information, and propose clear conclusions.

- Responsibility, discipline, organization, and attention to detail.

- Strong oral and written communication skills to explain technical information clearly.

- Customer-oriented mindset and willingness to provide technical support.

- Willingness to create simple, useful, and educational audiovisual material.

- Interest in working in an international and intercultural environment.

What We Offer

You’ll prioritize urgent issues, keep preventive maintenance on cadence, and drive down cycle times. This is a performance role with clear SLAs, daily accountability rhythms, and growth into senior coordination/ops leadership.

Work Order Intake & Triage

Receive requests via portal/phone/email; log with complete scope, photos, access info, and priority tag.

Classify by Priority (P0–P3) and building/owner rules; verify warranty/recall/recurring issues.

Scheduling & Dispatch

Assign to the right vendor/tech based on trade, SLA, geography, availability, and cost.

Build and update daily/weekly schedules; confirm tenant access, lockbox codes, pet/alarms, parking.

Create and track Not-to-Exceed (NTE) amounts; obtain approvals when required.

Ensure COI/W-9/licenses are current; validate arrival/completion, photo proof, and written diagnosis.

Request quotes for >NTE jobs; compare scope/price; route to approval.

Provide clear ETAs, prep steps (water shutoff, clearing access), and progress updates.

Set expectations for parts lead times and follow-ups; confirm satisfaction at completion.

Escalate sensitively when work impacts health/safety or habitability.

Maintain seasonal PM calendars (boilers/furnaces, gutters, dryer vents, smoke/CO checks, filter changes).

Batch/schedule PMs to minimize tenant disruption and travel time; track completion.

Invoicing & Close-Out

Ensure work orders have diagnosis, materials, labor, before/after photos, and time stamps.

Match invoices to WOs, verify against NTE, route exceptions, and submit to accounting the same day.

Emergencies & After-Hours Coordination

Follow the P0/P1 emergency SOP (gas/water/electrical hazards, no-heat, lockouts).

Coordinate on-call vendors, city services, and temporary mitigation.

Reporting & Quality

Produce daily/weekly reports on SLA adherence, WIP aging, cost variance, and vendor performance.

Flag repeat issues, recommend root-cause fixes (access hardware, part stocking, vendor changes).

description:
Senior Meta Ads Strategist & GoHighLevel Specialist (Philippines, Remote)

About Us



We're a fast-growing marketing agency based in Dubai that helps roofing and renovation companies across the UK generate more leads, more appointments, and more booked jobs through Meta advertising.



We currently work with approximately 40 active clients and have a team of 7 specialists covering paid advertising, CRM automation, lead nurturing, appointment setting, and operations.



We're now looking for an exceptional Meta Ads Strategist to take ownership of our clients' advertising performance across both Meta Ads and GoHighLevel — someone who thinks beyond lead volume and CPL, and understands that the real measure of success is booked, completed jobs for our clients.



This is not a junior media buyer role. This is not a role where you'll be handed SOPs and told exactly what to do.



We're looking for someone who can confidently walk into an account, diagnose why leads aren't converting into booked jobs, build winning campaigns, and drive measurable growth with minimal supervision — someone who spots gaps in our systems and proposes better ways of doing things, rather than just executing what's already there.



Who We're Looking For



We are looking for an A-player — someone who genuinely understands Meta lead generation better than the average agency owner, media buyer, or freelancer.



You should be highly analytical, highly proactive, comfortable making decisions based on data, and genuinely innovative — someone who improves the systems they work in, not just operates within them.



You should have significant experience generating leads for service-based businesses using Meta Ads, be genuinely proficient in GoHighLevel, and be able to explain exactly why campaigns succeed or fail — including when a campaign generates plenty of leads but not enough booked jobs.



If you've worked with roofing companies, home improvement companies, contractors, trades, or local service businesses, that's a major advantage.



Minimum Requirements



Essential

- 5+ years running Meta Ads professionally

- Managed at least $1–2M USD in Meta ad spend throughout your career

- Excellent written English

- Comfortable working UK business hours

- Able to join daily team calls

- Able to work independently without constant management



Preferred

- Experience with roofing or renovation companies

- Experience with home improvement businesses

- Experience with high-ticket lead generation

- Experience working within agencies managing multiple client accounts

- Experience suggesting or building GoHighLevel automation/workflow improvements, not just operating what's already built



Your Responsibilities



Meta Campaign Management

- Build and launch Meta advertising campaigns

- Manage and optimise existing campaigns

- Monitor daily performance across all client accounts

- Scale successful campaigns

- Identify underperforming campaigns and improve results

- Conduct ongoing split testing

- Monitor lead quality, not just lead volume



Strategy & Full-Funnel Ownership

- Diagnose the full funnel from ad click through to booked job, not just campaign metrics in isolation

- Work closely with our appointment setting and confirmation team to improve show-up and booking rates

- Use GoHighLevel automation to improve booking conversion, not just lead capture

- Make strategic recommendations based on data, including where the funnel is losing bookings



Creative Strategy

- Develop new ad angles and campaign concepts

- Write compelling ad copy

- Create hooks and offers

- Brief our video editor on winning creatives

- Analyse creative performance and iterate quickly



Performance Analysis

- Track KPIs across all accounts, with booked jobs as the primary success metric

- Analyse lead quality and booking conversion

- Monitor CPL, conversion rates, booked appointments, booked jobs, and revenue outcomes

- Produce clear recommendations for improving results

- Identify trends across multiple accounts



Client Success

- Ensure clients receive consistent lead flow and consistent booked jobs

- Take ownership of campaign performance end to end

- Work closely with our internal team to maximise results

- Contribute ideas that improve client outcomes



The Core Target



Our clients need a **minimum of 15 booked roofing/renovation jobs per month**. This is the number that matters most — not just leads generated or cost per lead. You'll be expected to think, report, and optimise against this outcome, working across both the Meta Ads and GoHighLevel side to close the gap between leads generated and jobs booked.



Salary & Growth Path



We believe in paying for proven performance, not just tenure. Your compensation will grow quickly if you deliver:



- $1,600 USD/month to start

- $1,800 USD/month after 60 days of proven performance

- $2,000+ USD/month after 90 days, for someone who's demonstrated consistent progress toward the 15-booked-jobs target and the ownership we're looking for



This isn't a token gesture — if you're the A-player we're describing, you'll see that reflected in your pay quickly.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days:

- Take ownership of approximately 30–40 client accounts

- Improve campaign consistency across accounts

- Reduce wasted ad spend

- Increase lead quality and booking conversion

- Make measurable progress toward the 15 booked jobs/month target per client

s on desktop, on mobile, and with images switched off

 HTML behaviour: how
s reflow on mobile, why images off matters, why heavy images clip in Gmail

HOW TO APPLY

 with your CV to

s you have built.

s/flows you personally built in Klaviyo. Screenshots or live preview links are both fine. Tell us what you built versus what someone else designed. If you have a portfolio please share it.

A note on AI: we work with AI systems daily, so we don't mind if you use one to tidy your application. # GoHighLevel Expert & Technical Automation Specialist

BoldMD helps entrepreneurs launch and scale cash-pay telehealth and longevity clinics.



**We don't just market clinics — we build them.**



Our team handles clinic infrastructure, CRM systems, automation, AI, patient workflows, sales systems, payment infrastructure, and growth strategy.

This is **not an entry-level GHL position.**



We need someone who understands GHL deeply but can also work outside of GHL when integrations, APIs, EMRs, payment processors, affiliate systems, or custom technical problems need to be solved.



---

* Have **advanced, hands-on GoHighLevel experience**

* Be available and actively working during **CST business hours**

* Have experience troubleshooting integrations and backend technical issues

* Be able to solve problems independently instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions



---

* Forms and questionnaires

---



# Affiliate & Referral Systems

title: Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions Tech VA
description:
Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions

Tech VA

experience, availability, and proven client-facing deployment capabilities

About the Role



We are looking for a Senior Client-Facing AI Automation & Solutions Tech VA who can bridge the gap

between client business needs and technical implementation.

This is not a purely execution-focused automation role. You will join discovery and sales calls, understand

the client's operational challenges, determine technical feasibility, recommend practical solutions, scope

implementations, and then take ownership of building, testing, deploying, and stabilizing those solutions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI automation specialist with strong client-facing and business

communication skills who can work independently with minimal supervision. You should be comfortable

turning ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions while maintaining realistic expectations

around scope, timelines, complexity, and fulfillment requirements.

Lead the technical portion of discovery conversations and uncover:

Current workflows and processes

Operational bottlenecks

Existing systems and tools

Business requirements

Automation opportunities

Desired outcomes and success metrics

cost, and deployment risk.

Solution Design & Scoping

Develop workflow maps, technical requirements, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and

estimated fulfillment requirements.

Assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risks, integrations, and potential blockers

before proposals are finalized.

AI Automation & Implementation



Build, configure, test, and deploy approved AI automation solutions.

follow-up sequences, and system integrations.

Integrate third-party platforms through APIs, webhooks, and automation tools.

Build and deploy solutions involving AI voice, SMS,
, lead reactivation, candidate engagement,

and appointment setting where applicable.

Ensure implementations are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the approved scope.



Testing, QA & Troubleshooting



Test every workflow end-to-end before client launch.

Validate integrations, triggers, actions, data flow, notifications, and edge cases.

Troubleshoot technical issues independently and resolve problems with minimal supervision.

Identify and address potential failure points before deployment.

Minimize technical errors, rework, and preventable scope changes.



Client Implementation & Post-Launch Support



Own client onboarding and implementation from approved scope through successful deployment.

Provide clear and proactive updates on progress, blockers, decisions, and next steps.

Create technical documentation and implementation records for every deployment.

Support post-launch stabilization and troubleshoot issues that arise after implementation.

Ensure reliable handoff and maintain stable, functioning automations after launch.

Identify potential expansion opportunities only after the initial implementation has produced a

measurable result.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Coordinate effectively with closers, account managers, developers, internal teams, and third-party

vendors.

Communicate technical requirements and implementation needs clearly to non-technical and

technical stakeholders.

Proactively manage dependencies and escalate critical blockers when necessary.

Manage multiple client opportunities and implementations while maintaining quality and

responsiveness.





Required Qualifications



Senior-level experience designing, building, testing, and deploying AI automation solutions for

external clients.

Proven experience participating in client discovery, technical consulting, or solution-selling

conversations.

Ability to ask strong technical and operational questions and independently identify appropriate

solutions.

Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into:

Technical requirements

Workflow designs

Implementation scopes

Timelines

Milestones

Deployment plans

Strong hands-on experience with:

CRM automation

APIs

Webhooks

AI agents

Lead qualification

Appointment booking

Follow-up automation

System integrations

Strong proficiency with GoHighLevel and leading no-code/low-code automation platforms.

Ability to assess technical feasibility, implementation complexity, risks, dependencies, and fulfillment

requirements before a proposal is finalized.

Excellent client-facing communication skills and strong business judgment.

Ability to avoid overpromising and set realistic expectations with clients.

Capable of working independently with minimal direction or hand-holding.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to document solutions and test workflows end-to-end.

Demonstrated ability to provide reliable post-launch support.

Must have verifiable examples of successful client deployments.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience supporting staffing, recruiting, professional services, or agency clients.

Experience building:

AI voice systems

SMS automation

 automation

Lead-reactivation campaigns

Candidate-engagement systems

Appointment-setting workflows

Familiarity with white-label AI automation agency delivery.

Experience supporting proposal development, solution demonstrations, and sales calls.



Knowledge of data privacy, permission management, and secure credential handling.

Experience managing multiple client implementations simultaneously.

Experience coordinating with closers, account managers, developers, and third-party vendors.

Strong understanding of client delivery processes and post-launch support.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means being able to take ownership of an opportunity from discovery → solution

design → scoping → proposal support → implementation → testing → launch → stabilization without

requiring continuous oversight.

You should be able to confidently answer:

“What does the client need, what is the best technical solution, how should we scope it,

how do we build it, and how do we make sure it works?”

You are expected to balance technical capability, business value, client experience, and

implementation risk in every solution you recommend.

Percentage of deployments delivered on time and within approved scope.

Successful end-to-end testing before client launch.

Client satisfaction and responsiveness throughout implementation.

Clear documentation and reliable handoff for every deployment.



Ability to manage opportunities and implementations without continuous oversight.

Stability and reliability of automations after launch.

Quality of technical recommendations and accuracy of implementation estimates.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a senior AI automation practitioner who can also operate confidently in front of

clients.



You are not simply someone who knows how to build workflows—you understand why the workflow

should be built, what business problem it solves, what is realistically achievable, and how to

successfully deliver it to a client.

You take ownership, communicate proactively, think commercially, troubleshoot independently, and are

Contract position

client-facing deployment capability

demonstrations of successful AI automation deployments

Opportunity: Long-term position working with an international business operating across the US, Europe, and Asia

1. Product Master Data Management



Manage and maintain accurate product master data including SKUs, UPCs/GTINs, barcodes, case configurations, dimensions, weights, ingredients, and other product specifications

Review product and packaging information for accuracy, including ingredient information and multilingual requirements

2. Retailer Onboarding & Account Administration

Support onboarding and ongoing administration for major US and European retail accounts

Support the completion of retailer-specific compliance forms, portals, templates, and documentation

Assist with EDI setup and coordination, working with external EDI partners, retailers, and internal stakeholders

Prepare and organize the data required for ERP migration, integration, and system setup



4. Logistics & Supply Chain Documentation



Help manage product, logistics, and supply chain documentation for US import and 3PL operations

Coordinate information between suppliers, factories, 3PLs, retail partners, and internal stakeholders

Track and manage inbound documentation requirements to keep operations on schedule



5. Compliance & Risk Management



Identify missing, inconsistent, or incorrect information before it creates downstream issues

Proactively flag potential compliance, data, or operational issues that could lead to retailer delays, chargebacks, or penalties



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years in operations, retail operations, supply chain, or product data — CPG, FMCG, food, beverage, or confectionery experience strongly preferred

Retail Knowledge: Experience supporting brands selling into major US retailers is highly advantageous; familiarity with retailer onboarding, item setup, vendor portals, and retailer documentation

title: Business Growth & Executive Assistant
description:
Seniority: Intermediate

Job Type: Contract / Full-time

Timezone: CST (Central) / CET (Central European) / GMT/UTC

Compensation: $800 – $1,000/month



Company Overview

The company exists to help private healthcare clinics (Dental, Eyecare, Wellness, Aesthetics) scale profitably and sustainably. We eliminate operational inefficiencies, boost patient engagement, and deploy custom AI-powered growth systems. We combine decades of business transformation experience with modern AI and automation to help ambitious clinics operate like high-performance businesses.



Role Overview



Reporting directly to the Founder & CEO, we are seeking an autonomous, tech-savvy, and growth-minded Business Growth & Executive Assistant. This is not a standard administrative role; you will serve as a direct force multiplier for the Founder—multiplying his time, supporting sales and marketing execution, and keeping client delivery organized.



In this role, you will bridge executive administration with modern technical tools, managing lead pipelines, formatting content, running automations, and organizing client setups as the firm scales.



Main Responsibilities & Focus Allocation



1. Sales & CRM Management (35%)

Lead Generation & Research: Assist with data scraping and lead research to identify ideal clinic profiles.

CRM & Pipeline Organization: Maintain and update prospect databases and CRM lead lists.

Outreach Execution: Monitor and support AI-powered cold
 campaigns (e.g., via Instantly/AI SDR inboxes), tracking performance and engagement.

Onboarding & Proposals: Assist with proposal drafting and technical client onboarding workflows as deals close.



2. Marketing & Content Support (30%)

Content Operations: Prepare and format content assets for B2B distribution, focusing heavily on LinkedIn.

Campaign Coordination: Assist with materials for AI content creation systems, newsletters, and Meta ad campaign assets.



3. Executive Support & Time Multiplication (25%)

Calendar &
 Management: Coordinate CEO scheduling, filter priority
s, and manage meeting logistics.

Administrative Organization: Keep digital files, client records, and internal documentation clean and accessible.



4. Operations, AI & Process Documentation (10%)

Workflow Automation: Utilize n8n and modern AI tools to streamline repetitive operational tasks.

SOP Development: Help document and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure repeatable client delivery.



Essential Qualifications (Must-Haves):



Proven Track Record: Minimum 3 years of experience in an Executive VA, Tech VA, or Business Growth Support role within B2B professional services or agency environments.

Automation & Tech Skills: Hands-on experience with n8n (or similar automation builders) and modern AI/SaaS tools.

Outreach & CRM Competency: Experience managing automated outreach inboxes (e.g., Instantly, AI SDR) and organizing CRM pipelines.

Executive Presence: Exceptional written English, proactive problem-solving skills, and a high degree of commercial awareness.



Preferred Skills (Nice-to-Haves):



Industry Familiarity: Prior exposure to private healthcare sectors (Dental, Eyecare, Wellness, Aesthetics) or B2B consulting models.

B2B Marketing: Experience formatting and scheduling thought-leadership content for LinkedIn.

SaaS Implementation: Familiarity with technical client onboarding, software provisioning, and account setup.



Key Personal Attributes:



Proactive & Growth-Minded: Takes ownership without needing step-by-step handholding.

Meticulously Organized: Exceptional attention to detail in execution and follow-through.

Tech-Savvy: Passionate about AI, business automation, and continuous learning.



KPIs & Success Metrics:



Executive Time Multiplication: Measurable reduction in CEO administrative workload, enabling focus on strategy and revenue generation.

Outreach & Lead Responsiveness: Fast response times and clean data tracking across AI SDR/cold outreach channels.

Automation & Process Efficiency: Reliable n8n workflow execution and continuously updated SOP documentation.

Onboarding Speed: Flawless, timely technical setup for new incoming clients upon contract execution



How to Apply:



Attach your resume to your application.

Include a link to a short Loom video introducing yourself.

Use the subject line "Lemons" so we know you read the full post.

title: Recruitment Specialist (High-Volume Talent Matching) — Remote
description:
About AI Acquisition



AI Acquisition is the global category leader in AI service-provider enablement. Operating globally, with the US as its primary market, our hybrid Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and AI marketplace model has achieved explosive growth by solving a critical pain point: connecting AI agencies with qualified enterprise opportunities at scale.

We combine proprietary AI orchestration tools with enterprise-grade SaaS infrastructure, delivering immediate value to agencies and SMBs worldwide.

We’re transforming how entrepreneurs build life-changing businesses by brokering AI tools to business owners eager to succeed. Positioned at the forefront of the $1.3 trillion AI revolution, we empower members to earn $500+ per hour with streamlined AI-powered systems.

Through our AI Agency Incubator, AI Accelerator, and AI Launchpad, we provide the systems, training, and support needed for rapid success.



Hear from Our Leaders:

Jordan Lee, Co-Founder & Chairman, shares insights about the business: 
/share/901416c6dac648acbe8a8b7fad8198d4



Why Join AI Acquisition?



You’ll join a fast-scaling, innovation-driven environment where agility, ownership, and excellence are core values. We operate with the speed of a high-growth company while supporting a global community of agency owners and business leaders who rely on AI-driven systems to scale.



If you want to directly contribute to revenue growth and operate in a performance-driven culture, this is the ideal place for you.



This is not a support role.



This is not admin work.



This is not ticket processing.



This is a specialist operational role at the intersection of payments, revenue protection, risk, and financial operations — where your work directly protects revenue, stabilises cashflow, and strengthens platform trust.



If you want to operate in a performance-driven environment where your expertise has real financial impact, this is the role.



This is not just work — it’s a high-trust specialist position inside a fast-scaling AI company.



For People Who Move Fast, Think Faster, and Get Things Done



Let’s be clear from the start…



This is NOT a slow corporate recruiting role.

This is NOT for people who need constant supervision.

This is NOT for clock-watchers.



This role is for someone early in their recruiting career who is obsessed with execution, hungry to grow, and excited to work inside a high-performance global talent environment.



If you love ticking boxes and waiting for instructions - this will feel uncomfortable.



If you love speed, ownership, and impact - you will grow extremely fast here.





About The Role

We support founders and fast-scaling companies globally by placing top remote talent across operations, sales, tech, and executive support roles.



Your mission is simple:

Find great talent ? qualify fast ? move them forward ? keep pipelines flowing.



This is a high-volume, high-urgency environment where your work directly impacts client success.



No hiding.

No silos.

No bureaucracy.



Just execution.





What You’ll Actually Do (Day-to-Day)

• Source candidates daily across multiple platforms (OnlineJobs, LinkedIn, job boards, talent communities)

• Screen applications with speed without sacrificing quality

• Conduct structured interviews to evaluate communication, reliability, and role fit

• Move qualified candidates through pipelines quickly

• Maintain organized trackers and ATS workflows

• Partner with senior recruiters to hit placement targets

• Keep candidate engagement high to prevent drop-offs

• Spot red flags early — and act on them

• Operate with urgency when roles go live



Expect 
ntum. Expect pace. Expect accountability.





Who This Is Perfect For



? 1–2 years in recruitment, sourcing, screening, or interviewing

? Comfortable speaking with candidates daily

? Highly organized and process-driven

? Strong written and spoken English

? Thrives in structured yet fast environments

? Naturally proactive - you don’t wait to be told what to do

? Emotionally resilient (recruiting involves rejection and unpredictability)



MOST IMPORTANT:



You take ownership.

You move fast.

You care about doing great work.





Who Should NOT Apply



Please save your time if:

• You prefer fixed, low-output workloads

• You struggle with changing priorities

• You dislike performance expectations

• You need micromanagement

• You are juggling multiple full-time roles



This is a serious opportunity for serious professionals.





What You’ll Gain

• Direct exposure to global hiring

• Learn elite recruiting workflows

• Work with experienced talent leaders

• Rapid career acceleration if you perform

• Real responsibility early

• A team that values execution over politics



High performers grow quickly here.





Working Style



This role requires strong availability and responsiveness during core working hours. (Global Timezone flexibility is required - 9+ working hours/day)



We operate in a collaborative environment where communication speed matters - especially when clients are hiring.



If you are energized by 
ntum, you will love it.





Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience supporting high-volume hiring

• ATS familiarity

• Startup recruiting exposure

• Strong sourcing creativity

• Interview confidence



(Not mandatory - mindset matters more.)





How To Apply (IMPORTANT)



To be considered, start your application with:



“High Ownership Recruiter”



Then answer this:



What makes you fast and reliable in recruiting? Give a real example.



Applications that skip this step will NOT be reviewed.



(We care about attention to detail.)





Final Note



We are building a team of people who give a damn, show up with energy, and want to become exceptional at what they do.



If that sounds like you - apply.



If not - this probably isn’t your environment.

title: WhatsApp Business & Meta Ads Specialist (Contract) — B2B Geospatial Solutions
description:
About the Role



We are seeking an experienced WhatsApp Business API and Meta Ads specialist to help scale our B2B outreach and lead generation efforts within the geospatial solutions industry. This is a contract position for a hands-on expert who understands how to build compliant, high-converting messaging and advertising funnels tailored to enterprise and technical B2B audiences (e.g., GIS professionals, surveying firms, engineering companies, government contractors, and infrastructure/mapping technology buyers).



The ideal candidate has deep, practical experience running WhatsApp Business API campaigns integrated with Meta Ads 
/Instagram) to drive qualified B2B leads, nurture prospects, and support sales conversion — specifically within technical or specialized industries, ideally geospatial, GIS, mapping, engineering, or related B2B technology sectors.



Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and manage WhatsApp Business API campaigns (Click-to-WhatsApp ads, automated flows, broadcast messaging, template message approvals).

- Plan and execute Meta Ads campaigns 
 & Instagram) optimized for WhatsApp lead generation and B2B conversion goals.

- Develop and manage WhatsApp conversation funnels, chatbot flows, and lead qualification sequences suited for a technical B2B buyer journey.

- Ensure all campaigns comply with Meta Business policies and WhatsApp Business messaging guidelines, including opt-in/consent requirements.

- Collaborate with the sales and marketing team to align messaging with geospatial industry use cases (e.g., GIS software, mapping services, remote sensing, spatial data solutions).

- Set up and optimize Meta Pixel/Conversions API tracking for accurate lead attribution.

- A/B test ad creatives, audiences, and messaging templates to improve cost-per-lead and conversion rates.

- Provide regular performance reporting and actionable recommendations.

- Manage WhatsApp Business account setup, verification, and API integration with CRM/marketing automation tools.



Required Qualifications

- Proven experience managing WhatsApp Business API campaigns for B2B companies (not B2C/retail).

- Demonstrated expertise in Meta Ads Manager, including Click-to-WhatsApp ad campaigns.

- Prior experience marketing to or within technical/specialized B2B industries — geospatial, GIS, engineering, construction tech, SaaS, or similar preferred.

- Strong understanding of B2B lead generation funnels and long sales-cycle nurturing strategies.

- Familiarity with CRM integrations (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) and marketing automation tools.

- Experience with Meta Business Manager, Meta Pixel, and Conversions API setup.

- Ability to work independently and manage deliverables under a contract/project-based structure.



Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience in the geospatial, mapping, GIS, or surveying industry.

- Experience with WhatsApp chatbot platforms (e.g., Twilio, 360dialog, WATI, or similar BSPs).

- Knowledge of account-based marketing (ABM) strategies for enterprise/government B2B sales.



What We're Looking For



A results-driven specialist who can hit the ground running — someone who has already run WhatsApp + Meta Ads campaigns for B2B clients and can bring proven playbooks, not someone learning on the job. Experience in or adjacent to the geospatial/GIS industry is a strong plus, given the technical nature of our buyer audience.



To Apply



Please submit:



Your resume/portfolio highlighting relevant WhatsApp Business API + Meta Ads campaigns.

Case studies or results from past B2B campaigns (metrics preferred: CPL, conversion rate, lead quality).

Confirmation of US-based work eligibility.

Your proposed contract rate (hourly or project-based).



This is a contract position. Rate and scope to be discussed based on experience and project requirements.

title: SDR (Neutral Accent)
description:
About Us



ToplineX builds B2B revenue growth engines that help companies generate predictable pipeline. We design and run signal-driven outbound systems 
, LinkedIn, and phone) that identify the right accounts, reach them at the right time, and turn them into qualified sales conversations. Our clients range across the B2B spectrum, typically selling high-value or complex offerings where a fast, thoughtful human touch turns interest into booked meetings.



We're looking for an SDR to own the pipeline: every positive reply, inbound lead, and past conversation, turned into held meetings.



What You'll Be Doing



You will work directly with the founder and own everything that happens after a prospect shows interest.



Your responsibilities include:



- Monitoring campaign inboxes and responding to positive replies within 15 minutes during working hours (AI assisted)

- Calling interested prospects to qualify them and get the meeting booked

- Running multi-touch follow-up sequences 
, phone, SMS) over several days with prospects who showed interest but didn't book

- Maximising show rates: confirmations, SMS and
 reminders, and re-engaging no-shows to get them rebooked

- Re-engaging inbound leads, older lists, and people we've spoken to in the past

- Keeping the CRM clean and up to date, with short daily activity updates and weekly pipeline reporting

- Supporting the founder in the sales motion: pre-call research, post-call follow-ups, chasing proposals

- Over time, taking ownership of outreach campaigns and building proactive plays to reach the right people at the right time



Goal: no interested lead ever goes cold. You own the gap between "positive reply" and "meeting held" so the founder can focus on sales calls and strategy.



What Success Looks Like



- Speed to lead: positive replies answered within 15 minutes during working hours

- Meetings booked, and more importantly, meetings held

- Show rate of 80%+ through tight confirmation and reminder sequences

- A pipeline where every lead has a next step and nothing slips through the cracks



Who Is This Role For



This role is perfect for someone who:



- Has worked in an SDR, BDR, or appointment-setting function before

- Is comfortable and confident picking up the phone and speaking to senior, high-value prospects

- Wants ownership and responsibility for the pipeline, not just task execution

- Understands the world of GTM and lead generation (cold
, outbound, how agencies work)

- Is proactive: spots opportunities and acts on them without being asked

- Likes working in fast-moving startup environments





Required Skills & Experience



Must have:



- Experience in an SDR, BDR, or appointment-setter role (B2B preferred), with results you can point to (meetings booked, show rates, campaign reports)

- Confident cold and warm calling: able to handle objections and convert a conversation into a booked meeting

- Fluent spoken and written English, with neutral/American accent

- Understanding of B2B outbound and lead generation fundamentals

- Comfortable using AI tools in your daily work

- Strong attention to detail and disciplined follow-up

- Ability to work autonomously once direction is given

- A professional remote setup: quiet workspace, headset, reliable computer, stable internet, and backup power/internet so you're never offline during working hours



Bonus if you have:



- Experience running automated outbound yourself (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Clay, or similar)

- Experience with LinkedIn outreach or social selling

- Experience writing or improving outbound and follow-up sequences

- Experience with CRMs and dialers



Working Styles & Expectations



- Full-time remote role

- Working hours aligned to US business hours, worked live (speed to lead is the job, so this is not a batch-work role)

- Fast execution environment with direct founder collaboration

- Short daily check-ins on Slack, weekly pipeline reviews





What's In It For You (+ Growth Opportunity)



This is a full-time salaried role from day one. In addition to base salary, compensation includes revenue share on the clients we sign, so your earnings grow directly with the pipeline you help build.



As the company grows, this role can evolve into:



- Senior SDR / Account Executive (running sales calls yourself)

- Owning the full pipeline function and leading future SDR hires

- Greater revenue share and performance incentives



We want someone who grows with us long-term, takes ownership, and benefits directly as the business expands.

title: Operations, Finance & Systems Assistant
description:
We’re looking for a highly organised, numbers-focused Operations & Finance Assistant to manage recurring back-office processes across our Australian businesses.



This is not a general VA role. You’ll work across Zenoti, Xero, payroll, reporting, stock, purchasing, recruitment and staff administration.



We need someone who can work independently, spot discrepancies and follow things through without constantly being reminded.



What You'll Do



Zenoti & Reporting

Maintain guest, service, retail and inventory data.

Pull sales, service, retail, utilisation, rebooking and cancellation reports.

Export and organise data in Google Sheets.

Investigate booking, payment and system discrepancies.

Open and manage Zenoti support tickets.

Process approved leave requests.

Review timesheets and prepare payroll.



Xero & Accounts

Enter and correctly document supplier bills.

Match invoices against purchase orders.

Flag pricing and invoice discrepancies.

Chase missing invoices and receipts.

Maintain supplier and recurring expense records.

Prepare weekly bills for approval.

Support reconciliation and accounts administration.



Stock & Purchasing

Maintain weekly stock records across locations.

Identify low-stock items.

Prepare and send approved purchase orders.

Track deliveries and chase suppliers.

Maintain unit and landed costs.

Match stock, POs and invoices.

Update Zenoti inventory where required.



Recruitment & Staff Admin

Post approved job listings and monitor applications.

Maintain candidate and recruitment databases.

Coordinate interviews and candidate communications.

Collect work-right, visa and onboarding documentation.

Add new employees to authorised systems.

Maintain staff files and onboarding checklists.

Chase outstanding paperwork and requirements.



What We're Looking For

Ideally you have experience with:



Xero or similar accounting software.

Payroll, accounts payable or bookkeeping administration.

Google Sheets / Excel.

Reporting and data management.

Stock and purchasing administration.

Business systems and process management.



Experience with Zenoti, Australian businesses, multi-location operations or beauty/salon businesses would be highly regarded.



Most importantly, you’re accurate, organised, proactive and good at figuring things out. We want someone who notices when something doesn't add up, investigates it and follows it through to resolution.

title: DTC Creative Strategist & Copywriter
description:
We’re hiring a DTC Creative Strategist to own paid social creatives and landing pages in our creative team — with a primary focus on persuasive, strategic copywriting.



Apply only if: you have 3+ years in DTC creative strategy and copywriting at an international e-commerce brand.



At Nordic Sculpt, we’re a lean, ambitious, high-performing remote team. We believe at-home beauty solutions should be effective, honest, and accessible to everyone. That’s why Nordic Sculpt exists—to bring integrity to our industry. We focus on what genuinely works: the same proven technologies clinics use, turned into simple at-home treatments.



Your Role:

This is a full-time, remote DTC Creative Strategist role. You’ll own the full-funnel creative strategy across paid social with copywriting as your main priority. Your responsible for creating ad briefings, writing high-converting copy for ads and landing pages, and continuously refine messaging and concepts based on insights and results. You’ll work closely with the Head of Growth and creative team, to grow the brand.



What we offer:

A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on results and personal development. Your impact is directly tied to brand growth and creative excellence. You’ll get access to courses, paid mentorships, advanced training, and direct guidance from top DTC marketing experts to refine your skills and accelerate your career.



Must-have requirements:

- 3+ years hands-on experience in DTC creative strategy and copywriting at an international e-commerce brand.

- Proven track record scaling brands to 7+ figures per month.

- World-class copywriting for DTC paid social marketing and landing pages.

- 10/10 understanding of full-funnel direct response.

- Market experience in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia preferred.

- Fluent English (spoken & written).



How to apply (strict):

- Record a short Loom video where you:

- Introduce yourself and share a bit about who you are and your background.

- Explain your DTC creative strategy approach, how you think about angles, storytelling, and performance when crafting ads.

- Walk us through your process for writing high-converting copy for creatives and landing pages, from idea to execution.

- Tell us why you think Nordic would be a great mutual fit and how you see yourself adding value to the brand.

- Attach your Resume or CV together with your Loom link.



Applications missing any item above won’t be reviewed.



Send your application and Loom video over Online Jobs.



We move fast, care about detail, and do not tolerate applications written by AI. If you’re a DTC Creative Strategist specialized in copywriting and thrives in a fast-growing team, we’d love to see your application.

title: Product / Ad Researcher
description:
Hi! We're hiring a Product / Ad Researcher — check the job below.



We’re looking for someone to help us find high-potential products, ads, competitors, and keywords using the Meta Ad Library, primarily across **European markets, with secondary markets including the US, UK, Australia, South Africa, and others.



Product Research — find Health & Beauty products that meet our criteria, with strong reach, active advertising, and plenty of quality ads to research.



Ad & Swipe Research — once a product is found, dig deeper to find more ads, creatives, angles, and variations around it.



Keywords & Competitors — find additional keywords, search terms, competitor pages, and advertisers that can uncover more ads for a specific product. The goal is to continuously feed our research system with strong, relevant data so we can discover more opportunities.



Market Expansion — when a product performs well, you’ll be expected to find additional competitors, pages, and advertising activity across different markets to further feed the system.



We’re looking for someone young, hungry, curious, and willing to grow with us. You don’t need to know everything — we want someone who learns quickly, takes ownership, and knows how to dig beyond the obvious.



We’ll train you on our system and criteria, but you should already be comfortable using the Meta/Facebook Ad Library.



Shift: 09:00–15:00 or 09:00–17:00 PHT, Mon–Sat. Pick one and stick to it.



Interested? Don’t reply in the comments — apply by
 to 



Subject: Product / Ad Researcher OG



* A 60-second intro video

* Portfolio or examples of products/ads you’ve researched

* One product + how you would find more ads, competitors, and keywords around it

* 5 keywords/search terms you would use for that product

* Your motivation — where do you want to be in 12 months?

* Preferred shift + confirmation Mon–Sat

* Hourly rate in USD OR monthly rate in USD (paid bi-weekly)



Missing one = not reviewed.



Following instructions is the first test.

title: Meta Ads Executive
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read below before submitting your application.

In the application form, you'll be required to submit a 2-minute video introduction answering: Who are you, and why do you think you're the best fit for this role?

You'll also be asked a few short written questions. If your video checks out, we'll invite you to interview.

In your application, use the Code: 8000. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.



Our creative and campaign execution directly impacts business growth.

Right now, we need someone who can build ads and quality check them before they ever reach a client account; not someone who uploads and hopes for the best.

We don't need someone who just "gets campaigns live." We need someone who understands that a single missed setting can cost a client real money, and treats every build like it matters.

We're not looking for someone who needs to be told to double-check their own work. We need someone who catches the error before we do.

— Andy Gray, Founder & CEO



WHO WE ARE

The Graygency is a performance marketing agency working with 7–8 figure DTC e-commerce brands across the UK, US, and UAE. We call ourselves Performance Scientists; we're in the P&L, not just the ad account. We're building an agency powered by systems, AI, and commercial thinking, not headcount.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO:

Campaign Build 

- Build Meta, TikTok and snapchat ad campaigns (and other paid social platforms as needed) from strategist briefs: campaign - structure, ad sets, targeting, budgets, creative uploads, copy, and UTM tracking

- Set up campaigns accurately, on spec, and on time, across multiple client accounts

- Follow naming conventions, folder structures, and account hygiene standards without being chased



Quality Control

- QC every campaign and ad before launch against a checklist: targeting, budgets, pixel/events, UTM tagging, ad copy, creative specs, and platform compliance

- Catch and fix errors before they go live, not after they've spent budget

- Own the final check on other people's builds as well as your own

- Flag inconsistencies or risks clearly and early, rather than letting them slide



Process and Support

- Maintain and improve build and QC checklists so quality doesn't depend on memory

- Support Media Strategists and Paid Social Strategists with day-to-day execution admin

- Keep clean records of what was built, checked, and changed, and when



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

- Campaigns go live correctly, first time, with no costly build errors

- Client accounts stay clean, organised, and easy for anyone on the team to pick up

- Strategists trust your QC as a genuine safety net, not a rubber stamp

- High volume of builds handled without a drop in accuracy

- Problems are flagged before they become expensive



THE SKILLS WE NEED YOU TO BRING:

- 1-2+ years hands-on experience building campaigns in Meta Ads Manager

- Genuinely detail-obsessed; you double-check your own work as a habit, not an instruction

- Solid understanding of Meta ad account structure (campaign / ad set / ad), targeting, budgets, and pixel/conversion events

- Comfortable working from a brief and following a checklist precisely

- Strong organisational skills; nothing falls through the cracks on your desk

- Able to work at pace across multiple accounts without cutting corners



NICE-TO-HAVES:

- Experience with TikTok Ads Manager or other paid social platforms

- Experience in DTC / e-commerce accounts

- Familiarity with tools like Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar reporting tools

- Exposure to AI tools for creative production or QA



WHAT WE OFFER:

- Competitive salary (based on experience)

- Fully flexible, remote working

- Paid public holidays and leave

- Direct collaboration with experienced Media Buyers and Strategists

- Clear progression into Paid Social / Media Strategist roles

- Opportunity to work on global e-commerce brands



RED FLAGS (Don't Apply if...)

- You're comfortable letting small errors slide because "it's probably fine"

- You need someone else to catch your mistakes for you

- You find checklists and process restrictive rather than helpful

- You struggle to keep multiple accounts organised at once

- You wait to be told something's wrong instead of flagging it yourself



OUR CULTURE

We believe in doing things well at The Graygency; we are constantly looking for ways to innovate and improve the delivery of our product. Every day we turn up and deliver our best work as a team in order to deliver the best results for the brands that trust us with their marketing budgets.



If you are ready to work and have the skills required, please submit your application directly here:

title: Outbound Cold Caller – B2B (Neutral/American Accent Required)
description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar





**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business 

- Outbound sales or appointment setting specifically. nNot inbound customer service

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?



3. **(30 sec)** Unscripted: respond to a prospect saying *"I'm not interested, we already have someone doing that."*



Also tell us in your message:

- Which businesses you've worked (company + region)

- Your internet setup (wired or WiFi, speed, backup plan)



Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.



**What happens next**

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.
